result.description: Fires on "logging" (also records, logs, tools) in well logging text about oil and gas and subsurface measurement. Silent on software or audit logging and reporting contexts.

result.description: Fires on the word after "replaced" (mostly " by", also " with" or the start of the replacement phrase like " more"), in replacement constructions. Silent on " by" after "driven" or "monitored".

result.description: Fires on ' to' (also 'the', word pieces) right after "contributions" in the phrase "significant contributions to". Silent on ' to' after other verbs or nouns, such as "led to" or "from X to Y". Members detect "contributions" and the following ' to'.
result.label: 'to' after "contributions"

result.description: Fires on tokens right after or within the phrase "in accordance with" (' the', possessive 's, 'or' in "investor's"), in business or corporate text. It stays silent after similar phrases like "in line with" or "aligned with".

result.description: Fires weakly on varied mid-word fragments and odd tokens (' organ' in organically, 'ient', ' j' in jenny, a digit, ' t'), mostly word-start pieces needing a continuation. Members are generic rare-token detectors; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Incomplete word fragments, mixed

result.description: Fires on the name "Rachel" (' Rach', 'el') and following ' Car'/' P' in the name Rachel Carson, mostly when the name appears inside running prose. It stayed silent on a "Rachel Carson" that starts a new line after a list of names.
result.label: Rachel Carson name pieces

result.description: Fires on mixed connector tokens (slash, comma, 'and', hyphen, apostrophe) between items in technical or title-like lists, often computing/software text. Peaks are inconsistent, and it is silent on '/' in names like OS/2. Evidence is weak.
result.label: Connectors in technical lists

result.description: Fires on list separators (' and', ',', ' or', '),') after a noun in a list of abstract business or organizational items, in positions where another noun item follows. It stays silent on some 'and' tokens before a final verb phrase in a list of verbs.
result.label: List separators between abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "life" (hyphen in "life-saving", "'s" in "life's", or " cycle"), i.e. the continuation slot after "life". Does not fire on hyphens after other words like "self-" or "X-".

result.description: Fires on a comma ending an item in a list of noun phrases (often before "and" or "including"), when the list is still going or about to close. It stays silent on commas after clauses or introductory phrases.
result.label: Comma after list item

result.description: Weak, mixed target peaking on ' in' (notably the 'in' in 'concrete in-equalities'), and on ' zones', ' confer', ' funds'. It stays silent on many ' in' tokens, and the members are generic. Looks like a diffuse circuit around inequality/variation text.

result.description: Fires on " further" used as an adverb right after a subject noun, before an active verb (e.g. "Wars further proliferated", "Cold War context further accentuated"). It stays silent when "further" follows a passive "were" or comes before a noun like "evidence".

result.description: Weak, mixed target firing on determiners and prepositions (' your', ' the', ' to') before a noun, plus a word-piece 'mole' in 'molecules'. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed, so the pattern is unclear.

result.description: Weak, diffuse attention-layer target firing on assorted function words and word pieces (for, to, and, the, learning, -ing) in academic or technical prose. Peaks are inconsistent and the same tokens are often silent, so the evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on 'istry' completing "Chemistry" in the phrase "Green Chemistry", especially at document start as a title. It stays silent on 'istry' in other chemistry contexts like "polymer chemistry" or "physical chemistry".

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after "lies" (also "lie", "rooted", "not only") in sentences saying where a quality or value of a topic resides ("the key lies in its ability"). Silent on ordinary locative or other uses of ' in'.

result.description: Weak, mixed attention-layer target peaking on scattered tokens (' against', 'ibration', ' to', ' prepar') in technical or academic prose. Members are generic token detectors with no discriminative ingredients, so the pattern is unclear.

result.description: Fires on the first digit '1' (or the space just before it) of a year, such as 1970 or 1980, after phrases like "early", "From", "the", or "in". It is silent on many other '1' year starts, so the condition is unclear.

result.description: Fires diffusely around "synergy"-style abstract text about blending or integrating things (synergy, balanced integration, "a form of"). Members detect combine/connect/partner/between words. Peak tokens are scattered, and it is silent on many " of" tokens.

result.description: Fires on ' and' right after the phrase "empirical evidence" (or similar empirical/observation terms), joining it to a following item like "the scientific method". It stays silent on ' and' after other lists or names.

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ak' piece ending "Tokamak" in fusion/plasma-physics text, with weaker firing on other fusion-device words such as " design" and " magnetic". Silent on 'ak' inside an unrelated word (otakushima).

result.description: Fires on ' while' (or ' whilst') as a contrastive conjunction right after a comma-ended clause, introducing a parallel contrasting clause. It is silent when 'while' follows a clause with no comma, such as 'advance plots during cliffhangers while slowing'.

result.description: Fires on verbs and function words (were, are, in, during, past participles) right after a plural or passive-style subject in expository history/economics text. The contrast shows it is silent on some 'were' cases, so it is inconsistent and the circuit is weak.

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside the name "Linnaeus"/"Linnaean" (na, eus, Lin, an), in taxonomy and classification text. Also weakly on pieces like "na" in other words. Members are mostly "na" piece detectors plus Lin and classification detectors.

result.description: Fires on the '9' in a 20th-century year (1957, 1961, 1960s, 1984) in space, satellite and technology-history text. It stays silent on some other years, such as 1962 and mid-1990s, so it seems to need a space or tech-history context.

result.description: Fires on commas and "and" (also "use", "to") separating items in lists about lifecycle, recycling, waste and sustainability. Silent on similar commas in other list contexts; the evidence is weak and the circuit failed.

result.description: Fires on varied function words and word pieces (' of', ',', ' purpose', 's', ' which', ' than') in abstract, technical expository text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low. Logits weakly favor ' and' and ' are'. The circuit is weak and unclear.

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' Cl' (and ' Ex') in a heading after "Open and" (Open and Closed), where the next piece completes the word. Silent on ' Cl' after "Between" or "of". Weak, low-faithfulness circuit.

result.description: Fires on varied tokens inside or ending items in comma-separated lists of abstract nouns (militarism, nationalism, aspirations; commas, 'and'). Peaks are scattered, and the circuit is weak and mixed, so the evidence is thin.

result.description: Fires on the "fs" piece completing "serfs" (ser + fs), in text about feudal social classes such as peasants and serfdom. Members detect feudal and class words and "serf" word pieces.

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens (word pieces, "of", "or", "rights", "institutions") in expository text, with no dominant token. It is silent on the physics contrast text. Members are generic and non-discriminative, so the evidence is weak.

result.description: Fires on the word right after "intersection" (mostly " of", also words like "considerations", "insights", "disciplines") in phrases about the intersection of fields. Silent on " of" after other nouns like "boundaries" or "structure".

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' arrow', 'als', ' making', ' charge') with no shared meaning. Members are generic, non-specific context latents. The circuit failed faithfulness and is near threshold, so the pattern is unclear.

result.description: Fires on the token right after "instrumental" (or similar "essential/fundamental to"), such as "in", "the", "various", or "personal", where a purpose or role complement starts. The contrast shows "the" after other "in" phrases stays silent.

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' events', ' on', ' probability', 'ent') in abstract text about events, probability and philosophy. Members detect 'events'/'event' and probability words. It is silent on 'events' in some everyday-life contexts. Evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on pieces and following separators in lists of materials after "sil-" words (silicone, silk, silicon), e.g. "ic", "icon", " and", ",". Silent on commas in other materials text, so it depends on the silicon/silk context.

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on scattered tokens (commas, 'but', 'of', 'enough', word pieces) in expository text. No dominant token or construction; members are generic token detectors. Failed circuit, evidence thin.

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "izers" completing "fertilizers", mostly after "synthetic fert(il)" in agriculture text. Members include detectors of "izers" and farming word pieces (crops, agriculture). Weaker on "izer" and on the comma after a fertilizers list.

result.description: Fires on word endings like "ments" in "metabolic rate adjustments" and " mod" in "metabolic modulation", in a repeated biology-adaptation list. Silent on "adjustments" in other phrasings. Evidence is weak; the circuit failed faithfulness.

result.description: Attention-layer target that peaks on the document-start token and also fires weakly on scattered mid-word or function tokens (' as', ' transfer', 'ing') in science text. Members are rare-token and word-piece detectors, so the evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the word after "highlight(s)" (often "the", or the noun like variety/beauty/colors) in food presentation and visual-aesthetics text. Also peaks on "ures" in some words, but stays silent on "ensures" and "gestures".

result.description: Fires on ' between' (and following 'and'/'reality') right after "blurring the lines/boundaries/line", where the next words name two things being blurred. Silent on 'between' after other nouns such as distinguish, tension, juxtaposition.

result.description: Fires on the first word or piece of a new item in a period-separated list of short topic headings (e.g. "Dynamic" Typing, "Res"pectful Listening). It is a weak, mixed circuit. It is silent on lists of person names.

result.description: Fires on 'on' (also 'into') right after nouns like perspective, insight, information, light that introduce a topic ("insights into", "perspectives on", "sheds light on"). Silent on 'on' as a physical or verbal preposition, as in "founded on" or "focuses on".

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in lists or technical noun phrases: slashes in codes, word pieces, ' units', ' gas', or an opening parenthesis. It seems to predict a continuation noun like 'investigation'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mixed list and technical-term tokens

result.description: Fires on a noun ending a technical compound noun phrase (e.g. "frequency reuse", "design methods", "body composition"), and on the following ' (' or ' and'. Silent on ' (' after some nouns. Evidence is weak and mixed.
result.label: Compound technical noun phrase endings

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in lists and mid-phrase positions (' that', ',', word pieces like 'ance', ' to') in abstract policy, economics and business prose. The peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse, so the target is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse mixed tokens in expository lists

result.description: Fires mainly on " though" in "even though" (concessive clause openers), with members detecting although/despite/while/even-if. Silent on "as though". Minor peaks on unrelated tokens like " Marshall" and " time".
result.label: "even though" concessive connective

result.description: Fires on the ' (' that opens an enumerated item number like "(1)" or "(2)", after a colon or semicolon in a list of points. It stays silent on ' (' that opens an explanatory aside such as "(such as ...)".
result.label: Open paren of numbered list item

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in technical or academic lists and noun phrases (commas in lists, 'ten' in molten, 'ver' in cantilever). Peaks are mixed and silent on many commas. Logits hint at research/scientific words. Evidence is weak.
result.label: Mixed technical list tokens

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of multi-token technical or academic words (lip-, Fin-, Cir-, endocr-), mostly in list-like or scientific text, where the word is still incomplete. Mixed evidence; weak circuit.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments in technical terms

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'roc' (atrocities), 'Param' (non-parametric), ' Lap' and 'of' in hyphenated "Out-of-", with no shared meaning. Peaks are scattered word fragments; the evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Scattered mid-word fragments (roc, Param)

result.description: Fires on the word "address" (Address, addresses, address-ing), often in IP/network contexts, and also on the hyphen in "trade-" (trade-offs, trade-related). Weakly on "street" and "function" as a first word of a compound. Mixed triggers.
result.label: address word and trade- hyphen
'amin' word piece (Lamin-ar, Vitamin)
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'amin' inside words like "Laminar" (and Vitamin), a mid-word fragment where the word continues. Mostly specific to this piece; weak activation elsewhere on other word-start fragments.

result.label: Word-piece starts: chem, chn, Lead-
result.description: Fires on incomplete word pieces that precede a suffix: ' chem' (before -istry), 'chn' (in Geotechnical), and 'ad' in 'Leadership'. Each is a mid-word fragment expecting a completion.

Fires on word-initial fragments of longer words that are split into pieces, mainly ' Est' (Estate, Estimation), ' manip' (manipulation), and ' saf'. It predicts a suffix continuation such as 'rage' or 'ates'. Members are mostly detectors of other word-start pieces.
result.label: Word-start fragment before suffix (Est, manip)

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings such as 'eters' in "kilometers" (before a parenthetical conversion) and on 'x' inside words like dioxide or in function notation u(x). Appears tied to unit and measurement words and chemical-word pieces.
result.label: Unit 'eters' and 'x' word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces, mostly 'age' in 'signage' (also 'wage', 'phage') and 'tons' in 'protons', after a word-start fragment. Silent when 'age' starts the text. Members detect 'sign-' stems and 'age' pieces.
result.label: '-age' suffix after word stem

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly function words or mid-phrase positions (' an', ',', 'iti', ' respond') where a noun or object is expected next. Peaks are inconsistent, and the circuit is diffuse with no clear shared meaning.
result.label: Diffuse mid-phrase function-word positions

result.description: Fires mid-word on the 'a' in "Versailles" (and similar mid-word pieces), and on the hyphen in "Event-driven". Seems to mark an unfinished word or compound where a specific continuation follows.
result.label: Mid-word 'a' in Versailles
Word-start fragments in long words
result.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, such as Rel(ationship), Govern(ance), Inst(rumental), Str-ateg-ic, voc(abulary). It mostly appears in title-like or technical text and expects the rest of the word to follow.

Fires on word-start fragments in linguistics/classification terms (typ-ologies, Ind-o, proto-, logographic, descri-), where a longer word is being built. Silent on 'o' in unrelated words like espresso or eloquent.
result.label: Linguistic/typology word fragments

result.description: Fires on ' which' used as a relative pronoun directly after a bare noun (no comma), as in "Leadership which controls...", predicting a verb. It is weaker after a comma and silent in some comma-preceded cases.
result.label: Relative 'which' after bare noun

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'lex' inside "reflexive" (ref|lex|ive), mostly in grammar text about reflexive pronouns. Silent when 'lex' starts the text without the 'ref' prefix.
result.label: 'lex' in "reflexive"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rib" at the start of a longer word (ribosome, ribonucleic, Attributable), and weakly on " speak". Members detect rib/chrom and molecular-biology word pieces.
result.label: "rib" word-piece (ribosome, attributable)

result.description: Fires mainly on " settled" in "transition from nomadic hunter-gatherers to settled agriculture", in prehistory/early-civilization text. Silent on "groups settled into", the verb use. Members detect primitive/ancient-civilization words.
result.label: "to settled" in nomadic-to-agrarian transitions

result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start fragments, mostly ' lear' (as in learner), also 'elf' in welfare and ' pa', where the next piece completes the word. Logits favor word-continuation pieces like 'pt', 'ide', 'iver'.
result.label: Mid-word fragment ' lear' (learner)

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'or' (also 'it', 'u') inside a split-up word such as euph-or-ic, serendip-it-ous or rhet-or-ic, where the word is still unfinished. It stays quiet on 'or' in other words like absorbed or sonorities.
result.label: Mid-word 'or' in euphoric/rhetoric

result.description: Fires mostly on " little" after an article or determiner (a little, that little, own little), and also on " behind" and word pieces like "ro" in "nitrogen". Members detect quantity words like little, much, less, no, some.
result.label: Quantifier 'little' and 'behind'

result.description: Fires on participle or conjunction words that precede an "as"-type complement, mainly "viewed" (as), also "presented", "served", "though/if" after "as". Mixed, weak consistency; members mostly detect "viewed/identified" past participles.
result.label: Viewed/identified "as" framing

result.description: Fires on the word ' in' when it follows a noun, name or phrase and begins a locative or topical prepositional phrase (e.g. "Sartre in Germany", "anyone in"). It stays silent on 'in' inside verb phrases such as "tune in", "steeped in" and "results in".
result.label: ' in' after noun, as preposition

result.description: Fires on a bare space token before a number (e.g. after a paragraph break or comma) and on apostrophes before "s/t/re". Silent on spaces after markdown headings. Mixed evidence; circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Space before digits, apostrophe contractions

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' dep' (and ' Cart'/' cart') when it begins a verb like "depict" in cartography/map text, e.g. "to dep|ict". It stays silent on "depiction" after "accurate". Members detect dep/cart/fr pieces predicting "ict".
result.label: "dep" before "-ict" in map text

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' more', ' thread', word fragments like 'l', 'Ind', 'ited') mid-phrase where a continuation or word completion is expected. Peak tokens are inconsistent and the circuit fails faithfulness, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' man' when it starts "manager(s)" (e.g. "project man|agers"), and weakly on a few other word-start pieces like 'pt' in "Adaptability". Silent on ' man' before "aging".
result.label: ' man' as start of "managers"

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens like 'ada' (Dada, adaptation) and 'trans' in 'neurotransmitter', plus occasionally ' the'. Members detect 'ada' and other mid-word pieces. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: 'ada' and 'trans' word fragments

result.description: Fires on subject pronouns ' they' or ' it' that start a subordinate clause after a conjunction like "that", "because", or "as", where a verb comes next. It stays silent after "how" in some contexts.
result.label: Clause-initial 'they'/'it' after conjunction

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' hyper' when it begins a word like hyperbole or hyperbolic, mostly in literary or rhetorical text. Upstream members are mainly ' hyper' token detectors plus other word-start piece detectors.
result.label: ' hyper' prefix (hyperbole)

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ism" ending philosophy-style isms in list-like headings (Physicalism, Subjectivism, Dualism). It stays quiet on "Symbolism" in literary or art contexts.
result.label: -ism suffix in philosophy terms

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' bos' in "boson" (W/Z/Higgs bosons) in particle physics text, and more weakly on 'an' in "Financial". It is a mid-word piece that expects a completing suffix.
result.label: ' bos' piece of boson

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside technical words, mainly 'amp' in "damping", 'och' in "mitochondrial", and ' trib' in "tribology". Members are detectors of these specific pieces. Weak, mixed elsewhere.
result.label: Technical word fragments: damp, mitoch, trib

result.description: Fires on compass direction words, mainly ' south' and ' north', especially within lists of cardinal directions (north, northeast, east, southeast, south...) or magnetic pole discussion. Members detect direction tokens.
result.label: Compass direction words in lists
Mid-word fragments in long words
result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of rare multi-piece words, such as 'ar' in camaraderie, 'bi' in symbiotic and 'e' in coevolution. It stays silent on 'bi' when the word starts the text or follows 'non-'.

Fires mostly on commas inside lists of items (e.g. "architecture, engineering," or "can, could, may, might,"), where another list item follows. It is silent on commas that start a clause, such as ", which" or ", while".
result.label: Comma within item lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments that start or continue a longer word, mainly "illing" in "drilling" and " abs" before "orb/urd", plus pieces like "h" in Aryabhata. Mixed fragments; the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Word-fragment: drilling, abs-, Aryabhata

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments mid-word, mainly 'ain' in "porcelain" and 'person' in "interpersonal", where a suffix like -al follows. Silent on 'personal' as a whole word.
result.label: Mid-word 'ain'/'person' fragments

result.description: Fires on the word " Food" (also " food") when it starts a heading or topic line in a list of course or topic titles like "Food and Identity". Weakly fires on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: Food in topic headings

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'ord' inside "primordial" (also "Chord", "Ford", "chordate"), with weaker firing on ' of' and 'ained'. Members are mostly 'ord' detectors in early layers.
result.label: 'ord' in primordial

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments mid-word, mainly ' Scient' in "Scientific Revolution" and 'l' inside split words (bott-l-enecks, over-l-ays), where the word is incomplete. Silent on 'l' in other words. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, Scient(ific) and l

result.description: Fires on the final piece of certain multi-token terms, such as "to" in "Pareto", " inheritance" after biological or genetic words, and "IC" in "BIC". It is silent on "to" inside names like Ptolemy and McClintock.
result.label: Word-final pieces: Pareto, inheritance, BIC

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside attentiveness/awareness adjectives and similar words (vig-il-ant, non-ver-bal, cogniz-ant, una-ware), but stays silent on 'ful' in words like meaningful, respectful, thoughtful. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of vigilant/verbal/cognizant

result.description: Fires on mid-name word pieces (' Gar', ' God', 'cia', ' Dr') inside lists of person names, one per line, e.g. "Dr. Garcia". Peaks are scattered and weak, so the pattern is mixed. Silent on lists of famous full names.
result.label: Name pieces in Dr. name lists

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in passages about industrialization, mechanization and technological revolution (e.g. 'mechan', 'revolutionized', 'techniques', possessive apostrophes). Silent on 'ization' in urbanization/globalization/quantization contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Industrial revolution/mechanization transformation words

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'cub' in cubic, 'ist', 'ap', 'ical', 'ic', 'trib', where a word is unfinished and likely to continue with a suffix. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low; the circuit is weak and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragment pieces (ist, ap, ical)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ch' in "crochet" and on 'R' in the acronym "HR"/"HRM", i.e. mid-word pieces of a longer term. It stays silent on 'ch' in "tech" or "changing".
result.label: 'ch' in crochet, 'R' in HR

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: ' <' starting HTML-like tags after a document start, ' contributions', ' information', and mid-word pieces like 'tra', 'ity', 'isse'. No single token or context dominates; the circuit looks diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse mixed tokens, ' <' and word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " thermal" as a modifier before a noun (thermal balance, solutions, systems), with a few other peaks (" F", "mic"). Silent when "thermal" starts a text or sits in a list of properties. Members are thermal/heat detectors.
result.label: ' thermal' before noun

result.description: Fires mainly on ' compress' (as in compressive/compressible) in engineering and materials text, with weaker firing on word pieces like 'or', 'ator', 'ents' in technical words. Members detect compress-, load, material and structural terms.
result.label: compress- in engineering text

result.description: Fires on word pieces mid-word, mostly ' gover' (before -ning/-ns) and 'ener' in 'greener'/'regeneration'. Weak partial-word pieces like 'stroke' and 'consum' also fire; peaks are scattered and the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: gover- / -ener word pieces

result.description: Fires on digit tokens ('1', '3', '8') inside multi-digit numbers, such as dollar amounts or long digit strings. Silent on a '1' used as a list heading number or in a fraction. Members are diffuse and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Digits inside multi-digit numbers

result.description: Fires on " it" right after the causal conjunction "as" (", as it can/is/requires..."), introducing a reason clause. Stays silent on " it" after commas, semicolons, or other words.
result.label: " it" after causal "as"

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: ' +' between algebraic terms (ax + ay +), ' back' (flashback, back in history), and 'ome' in 'biomechanics'. Mixed word pieces with no shared meaning; the circuit is weak and fragmented.
result.label: Mixed: ' +', ' back', 'ome'

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "ci" inside multi-piece words such as reprodu-ci-bility, de-ci-bel, spe-ci-atory, with a few other mid-word pieces (ate, air, beg). Members are mostly "ci" detectors.
result.label: 'ci' piece in reproducibility

result.description: Fires on the 'ate'/'ates' piece completing "Plate" (tectonic plate, Plate-au) in geology text. It stays silent on 'ate' in other words like "migrate" or "disproportionate". Members detect plate/tectonic context and "pl-" prefixes.
result.label: 'ate' in tectonic Plate

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract or scientific head noun (types, fabric, dynamics, shape) in intellectual, science-flavored prose, where a noun phrase like 'these' or 'our' follows. Silent on other ' of' uses, such as 'core of' and 'periods of'.
result.label: ' of' after abstract science nouns
Word fragments in cookware/grill words
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'ill' in grill, 'ain' in porcelain, 'sk' in skillet, and on ' periodic'. Mostly cooking and cookware word fragments, with a weak, mixed pattern.

Fires mostly on the word piece "pos" inside "Prepositions" in grammar headings at document start. It also fires weakly on scattered pieces such as Russian "от", " на", and Arabic or Japanese fragments. Evidence is mixed, with a consistency of 36%.
result.label: "pos" in "prepositions" headings

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (commas in lists of places, 'most' in 'mostly', '-ans' endings, 'approximately') mid-sentence in expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse; logits mildly favour adjective-like continuations such as economic, urban, advanced.
result.label: Diffuse mixed function-token latent

result.description: Fires on quality nouns like accuracy, reliability, consistency, precision when they are the object right after "ensure" (or "ensuring"). It stays quiet on the same words after "of", "between" or "as well as".
result.label: Quality noun after "ensure"

result.description: Fires mainly on ' expert' as a word start (expert systems, expertise), after "of" or "encapsulating". Weaker on other word-start pieces like 'est', 'innov'. Silent when "expert" begins a text as a plain adjective.
result.label: ' expert' in expertise/expert systems

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'ening' piece of 'Listening' in heading lists of listening types (Selective Listening, Appreciative Listening), and weakly on ' listening'. Silent when 'ening' is in other words like 'strengthening'.
result.label: 'ening' in Listening headings

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (work, of, their, -ence, cultural) in passages about art, creativity and culture, often mid-phrase before a noun. Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak and diffuse, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered tokens in arts/culture prose
' mod' stem before -ulation/-ular
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mod' when it begins a longer word such as modulation, modular, modality or modifier. Members are mostly ' mod' detectors. It is weakly active on 'manip' in manipulating, and silent on the whole word 'manipulate'.

Fires on scattered mid-phrase tokens in abstract academic prose (' methods', ' established', ' to', '-', ' while'), with no single token dominating. Silent on ' methods' in some contexts, but the evidence doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: Scattered academic-prose tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the token piece "inos" completing "neutrinos" (e.g., "tau neutr|inos"). Members detect "inos"/"ino"/"neut" pieces, including "lum|inos|ity", plus physics context. Weak firing elsewhere in math text.
result.label: "inos" in neutrinos

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer words, most often 'ent' in "relentless" and "relates", where more word pieces follow. It stays silent on 'ent' in "inherent", where the word is complete. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Mid-word piece, as in rel-ent-less
Word-initial fragments: W, subs, Orth
result.description: Fires on the start of a multi-piece word where a continuation is expected, mainly ' W' (Wave, Woolf, WWI), ' subs' (subsidies) and ' Orth' (Orthographic), and sometimes ' to' after "continues". Silent on ordinary text.
Fires on the word piece 'pler' ending the name Kepler, after 'Ke'. It stays silent when 'pler' appears at the start of a text without the preceding 'Ke'.
result.label: 'pler' in Kepler

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "work(s)" in the sense of creative works ("works of art", "work of others"). It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "form", "story", "boundaries" or "nature".
result.label: " of" after "work(s)"

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'pend' in "perpendicular" (also ' dens' in "denser/density"), in technical math/science text. Members detect word-start fragments of technical terms (precip, cart, dist, per-me).
result.label: 'pend' in perpendicular

result.description: Fires mostly on " Symbol" in title-like headings of the form "X as Symbolism" (after "as"), with weaker firing on pieces like "person" and "against". The evidence is thin and mixed beyond the " Symbol" cases.
result.label: "as Symbol(ism)" heading

result.description: Fires on ' the' (sometimes ';') beginning a new item in a parallel list or series of comparable noun phrases, e.g. "be it the roughness of X, the softness of Y, or the crispness". Silent on ' the' in ordinary non-list positions.
result.label: ' the' opening parallel list item

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (composition, horizon, object, Religion, Electron, predator) that are the head noun or word right after a science-topic context word like soil, in, or and. It is inconsistent, and it stays silent on some 'composition' contexts.
result.label: Noun after science modifier (soil composition)

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in title-like headings of geography/geodesy topics, e.g. the word after "Geomorphic" or "Geodetic" in a multiword technical term (Mapping, Positioning). Weaker on function words like "is". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Geo-technical heading term continuation

result.description: Fires on the 'ishing' piece in "distinguishing", mostly before "between"; weaker on "differentiate". Members detect distinguish/differentiate word pieces and "between", and the output pushes toward ' between'.
result.label: distinguishing (ishing) before between
' coh' word-start fragment
result.description: Fires on the word-initial fragment ' coh' (coherent, cohesive, cohomology), and sometimes ' hip' or other word starts, where the rest of the word must follow. It was silent on one 'social coh' (cohesion) example.

Fires on the token ' ocean' in marine and earth-science text (oceanic currents, chemistry, temperatures). Members detect ocean, marine and sea tokens. It stayed silent on one 'open ocean' case, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: ' ocean' in marine science text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in academic text, mostly mid-word pieces (neuroplastic, biocompat, stylistic) and list separators like commas or 'and' within a series of items. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Mid-word pieces and list separators

result.description: Fires on commas and 'and'/'or' inside lists of concrete resources or materials (oil, gas, coal, water, minerals), after a list item. Silent on commas in abstract clause-level prose. Oil/gas members support it.
result.label: List separators in resource/material lists

result.description: Fires on 'current' (esp. sentence-initial "Currently," after a period) and on ' also' after a subject/period noun, both sentence-adverb-like positions. Silent on 'current' at document start.
result.label: Sentence-initial 'current(ly)' and 'also'

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and function words (' resp', ' and', ' M', 'ou', 'ppings') where a word is incomplete or a multi-token word or phrase continues. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Diffuse mid-word fragment feature

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' p' right after "plays a" / "a" (as in "plays a pivotal role"), and weaker on 'al' in "convolutional" and 'layer'. Silent on ' p' in other contexts, such as "have been pivotal" or "private payer".
result.label: ' p' of "a pivotal" role

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'al' in "focal" (also 'ruct' in "non-destructive"), where the word continues or is completed. Silent on 'al' in "reveal" or "visceral". Mostly a "focal" detector with scattered other word pieces.
result.label: 'al' in "focal" word piece

result.description: Fires on the token " identity", most strongly in "the identity matrix" in linear algebra text. It is silent when " identity" begins the document with no preceding context. Members are mostly detectors of " identity" and similar words.
result.label: ' identity' token (identity matrix)

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens in academic/expository prose (' focused', ' later', ' significant', ' important', 'ates', ' difficulty'), often mid-phrase where a noun or continuation is expected. Peaks are inconsistent and members are generic; the evidence is weak.
result.label: Scattered academic-prose tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the word " inverse", mostly in matrix/linear-algebra text (inverse matrix, inverse square matrix). It is silent on related math text that doesn't contain the word, such as determinants and invertibility. Members detect inverse and nearby math words.
result.label: ' inverse' in matrix text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' l', ' your', ' method', ' imm', 'for') in cooking/dough text, especially mid-word pieces like dough-"l"-amination. Silent on ' l' in other food contexts such as lamb. Members are mostly cooking and food detectors.
result.label: Dough and cooking-technique tokens
Mid-word pieces: -centric, kinetics, 'more and'
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ric' in user-centric, 'inet' in kinetics, and 'ed' in user-centered, plus ' and' in 'more and more'. Members mostly detect 'ric' word pieces. Mixed evidence, with no single token dominant.

Fires on ' of' right after a nominalized head noun in a title or heading (e.g. "The Basics of", "The Role of", "The Evolution of"). It stays silent on ' of' in ordinary running prose, such as "a Glass of Water" or "understanding of the".
result.label: ' of' in title-style headings

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments early in a longer word, mainly 'ac' (inaccurate, polysaccharides), ' vel' (velvet), 'roid', ' Mediter'. It needs the piece to be inside a multi-token word that the next piece completes.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: ac, vel, Mediter

result.description: Fires on word endings of attribution/notability words, mainly "cred-ited", also "noteworth-y" and "not-ably". Appears in phrases like "credited with/to" and "noteworthy for". Members detect passive participles such as referred, identified, viewed.
result.label: Credited / noteworthy word endings

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in art/craft vocabulary, mainly 'roid' in embroidery, plus 'ouve' in Art Nouveau and ' Trad' in Traditional. Weakly on 'ourd' in other words. Mostly a word-piece detector in art-themed text.
result.label: 'roid' in embroidery, art word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer technical word, mostly ' assist' (assistive, assistants), plus 'ics' in kinetics, 'ar' in radar, and 'ing'. It seems to predict a suffix completing the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragment: assist-, kinet-ics
' persu' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' persu' at the start of persuade/persuasive/persuasion, mostly in writing about communication and rhetoric. It stays silent when ' persu' begins the document, where there is no preceding context.
Fires on ' last' as a verb stem in "which lasted" (a period or era that lasted from...), and weakly on "but rather". Silent on "the last several" (adjective use).
result.label: "which lasted" verb 'last'

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " Pl" in capitalised title or heading text, such as "Media Pl(anning)" or "Belt Pl(ate)". It also fires weakly on "UI" and "tz". Upstream members detect " Pl" and " pl" pieces.
result.label: " Pl" piece in headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' brid' (start of bridge/bridging/bridges), mostly in network or engineering text. Members detect ' brid', 'bridge' and similar split-word stems like ' mer' (merging) that are followed by 'ge/ging'.
result.label: ' brid' word-piece (bridging)

result.description: Fires on mixed mid-word or word-joining pieces: hyphens after a first word (life-, state-), the end of "Clause", digits inside date or fraction strings, and fragments like "Roc". No single token dominates, and the logit effects are weak.
result.label: Hyphens and word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on ' theory' (also mathematics, geometry, -ology endings) when it completes an academic field name in math/science text, strongest in "number theory". Silent on "theory" in other uses such as "systems theory", "between theory and application".
result.label: Math field name ending: number theory

result.description: Fires on ' world' (occasionally ' landscape') when it follows a domain adjective or noun, as in "the culinary world" or "the business world", meaning a sphere or field. It stays silent on "around the world" or "In a world where".
result.label: Domain "world" as sphere/field

result.description: Fires mainly on ' closely' after a form of "is/are" in "closely linked/related/tied" phrasing, with a few stray peaks on 'G' in JPEG/MPEG. Members detect 'closely'/'close' and similar adverbs.
result.label: ' closely' before linked/tied

result.description: Fires on short tokens such as '3', '0', 'FF', 'W' and 'P' that act as subscripts, variable names or acronym pieces (P_0, MP3, WAV-like formats). Members come from audio, compression and music topics. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Short symbol/format-code tokens (P_0, MP3)

result.description: Fires on the token " mass" (also " Mass"), most strongly in "mass production/media/marketing" before a noun. It fires more weakly for physics "mass" (spectrometry, atomic mass). Members are mostly "mass" token detectors.
result.label: ' mass' token detector

result.description: Fires on varied word-ending or closing pieces: the LaTeX closer ' \)' after a variable, suffixes like 'ous', 'dimensional', 'DP', 'oth', 'ary'. Mostly math/science text, where it marks a word or symbol that is just completed. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Math/science word-ending and \) closers

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' glo' in "across the globe" and on 'on' in "Microcanonical"; weaker on mid-word pieces like 'fa' (fauna) and 'minor'. Mostly an incomplete-word piece predicting a continuation like "be".
result.label: Word-start piece 'glo' (globe)

result.description: Fires on capitalized name-start word pieces such as ' Gree' (Greeks), ' Rom' (Romantic), and ' Stuart' (Hall), mostly in academic text. These are fragments that precede a completing suffix, and the peaks are mixed. The evidence is thin.
result.label: Name/word-start fragments Gree, Rom, Stuart

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' conclus' (conclusions, conclusive) mid-word, and also on 'rane' in 'membrane'. Mostly academic or logic and argument text, with members detecting 'conclus' and similar word pieces.
result.label: ' conclus' and 'rane' word pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on " figure" as a noun, especially "a towering/seminal/eminent figure" describing an important person, with weaker firing on a few other tokens like "ely". Members are mostly detectors of figure/figures in earlier layers.
result.label: ' figure' after adjective, notable person

result.description: Fires on the last piece of a multi-token math term or heading (Num|bers, Enumer|ation, 'angle' in words like triangle) in mathematical title lists, especially combinatorics. Members are math-term detectors. Mixed token peaks.
result.label: Math term word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces (-able in "accountable", -ity, -back, -izing, -uring) and "possible" completing a word or phrase. Silent on "able" in indispensable and unsolvable. Evidence is mixed and the members are diffuse.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (accountable)

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' where', 'liance', '&', ' dis', ' to') in business/management-style text, especially 'areas where' and 'barriers to'. It stays silent on other uses of ' where'. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Business text 'areas where' mixed

result.description: Fires on the final 's' of "Bretton Woods" (the conference/system), after "Bretton Wood". Silent on other 's' tokens such as possessive 's or decade 's. Members detect Bretton/Wood pieces plus economics context.
result.label: 's' in Bretton Woods

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after "allow(s)/allowed" (also "enable", "facilitates") when a verb says something makes an action possible, as in "allows for the analysis". Silent on ' for' after nouns such as "foundation for".
result.label: allow/enable 'for' after enabling verbs

result.description: Fires weakly on varied tokens, mostly mid-word pieces or function words (' suffering', ' myster', 'ia', digit '5', ' of', ' set'), with no clear shared context. Logits favor word-continuation pieces. Circuit is diffuse and unfaithful.
result.label: Diffuse mixed mid-word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on ' force' ending physics noun phrases like "drag force" or "resistance force" in fluid-dynamics text, with weaker hits on ' conditions', ' motion', ' profile' and "on" in "phenomenon". Silent on 'force' in other senses.
result.label: Physics 'force' after drag/resistance

result.description: Fires mostly on ' bow' (as in bowl/bowling/bow style) and scattered other tokens like ' hair', 's', ' become', ' and'. Members detect word-start fragments (bow, viol, bu, Rot). Mixed and weakly faithful, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: ' bow' word-piece detector, mixed

result.description: Fires on the word piece completing "empath-" words (empathetic, empathic, empathy) and on the communication-related word after "empathetic" (e.g. "listening", "hearing"). Silent on "etic" in "aesthetic", so it needs the empathy context.
result.label: Empathetic/empathic suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on ' as' (occasionally ' like') in the "such as" exemplifying construction, right before an example list after a general noun. Silent on other uses of ' as' such as comparisons or conjunctions.
result.label: "such as" introducing examples

result.description: Fires mainly on 'el' completing "Diesel" (Diesel engine/cycle/fuel) in technical text, but not on 'el' in fusel-age, propel or biodiesel. Occasionally on other tokens like ' Foreign' or 'uth'.
result.label: 'el' in "Diesel"

result.description: Fires on "logic" (and the "ic" in "Logic") when it ends a named type of logic such as second-order, propositional, fuzzy or modal logic, in formal logic or math/CS text. Silent on "standard logic" in a symbols sentence.
result.label: Logic in named logic systems

result.description: Fires on the word " drug" as a modifier noun in scientific or technical text (drug design, drug development, drug efficacy). Members are mostly detectors of " drug" and related biomedical nouns like gene, disease and tissue.
result.label: ' drug' in biomedical compounds

result.description: Fires on the "edy" piece in "Greedy" (greedy algorithms/methods), in computer-science or optimization text. Weak activation on a few other word pieces like "Fram-ing" and "chaos theory".
result.label: "edy" in Greedy

result.description: Fires on ' creation' (also conception, formation) when it names a stage in a lifecycle or process, as in 'from conception to creation' or 'design creation, deposition'. Silent on other process words in the contrast.
result.label: creation as process stage

result.description: Fires on relation nouns like "relationship", "connection", "interdependence" that are expected to be followed by "between", especially right after "The" at the start of a document. Silent on "the relationship" mid-sentence in the contrast example.
result.label: Relationship/connection noun before "between"

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments right after "ch" (ch-ess, ch-ances, ch-ick, ch-ord) and a few other mid-word pieces like "ASSE-SS". It stays silent on the suffix "ess" in "shallowness", so it needs the "ch" onset.
result.label: "ch" + word-piece continuation (chess, chances)
' how' as embedded clause opener
result.description: Fires on ' how' introducing an embedded clause after a verb or preposition (knowing how, determines how, on how, counting how). It stays silent on ' how' beginning a direct question at document start.

Fires on mixed word pieces and words in academic or technical text (' normal', 'ertain', 'ict', ' broad', ' relative'), often mid-word or at the start of a longer word. Peaks are scattered, and the logits and members show no clear pattern.
result.label: Scattered word-piece fragments in technical text
Word-start pieces before a suffix
result.description: Fires on incomplete word pieces such as ' dru' (before "gs") and 'power' in "AI-powered", where the word continues with a suffix. Peaks are mixed (dru, power, real, side), so the common thread is a mid-word fragment.

Fires mostly on ' composition' and on word pieces like -ization/-ation (e.g. polarization), in science/chemistry text. Peaks are mixed, and it weakly pushes suffix-like continuations. The circuit is low-faithfulness and diffuse.
result.label: composition and -ization suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word or compound pieces such as hyphens in 'step-by-', 'sh' in 'handshake', 'que' in 'torque', and symbols like τ, μ or the 2 in CO2. It seems to expect a word continuation. Mixed evidence; hyphens are only partly specific.
result.label: Hyphen and mid-word continuation pieces

result.description: Fires on a mix of word-ending or word-start tokens, mainly ' turn' (as in turnover), ' view' in "point of view", and ' close'. Peaks are scattered, so the pattern is mixed and low-consistency. The logits show no clear next-token pattern.
result.label: Mixed: turn(over), point of view

result.description: Fires on short Cyrillic syllable fragments (ку, ско, де, на) inside garbled, nonsensical pseudo-Russian text. Members mostly detect Arabic/Cyrillic/Japanese word pieces. Weak and inconsistent; faithfulness is poor.
result.label: Cyrillic syllable pieces in garbled text

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings mid-word, mainly 'ness' in "har-ness-ing", also 'ing' in "light-ing" and 'cent'. Silent on 'ness' as a noun suffix (consciousness, alertness, boldness). Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: harness-ing / lighting word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' batt' (as in "battles") and ' brut' (as in "brutal"), mostly in war and fighting contexts. It fires on the unfinished word piece, before the word is completed.
result.label: ' batt' / ' brut' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'il' inside scientific terms (nucleophilic, electrophil-, fertilization), plus 'ity' and separators like '-' or '/' in number strings. Mixed and weakly consistent; the circuit is a poor fit.
result.label: 'il' word piece in science terms

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes ' or') joining two abstract nouns or noun phrases in academic-style text, e.g. "cultural identity and displacement". Quiet on ' and' after commas or joining clauses.
result.label: ' and' joining abstract noun phrases

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' in', possessive 's, ' the', word pieces) right after a subject noun in academic or technical text, where a verb or predicate is expected next. It is silent on ' in' after 'results in' or 'increase in'.
result.label: Subject noun before predicate, academic text

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: surnames in lists of "Dr./Professor Name" lines (Davis, Jenkins, Williams), plus word-piece 'im' inside words, and occasional ' to'. Mixed peaks with low consistency; no single clear condition.
result.label: Surnames in title lists, 'im' pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' O' (also ' star'/' Star'), mostly the O of Big-O notation in algorithm complexity text, and also on O as a standalone letter in lists. Members are mostly ' O' token detectors.
result.label: Letter ' O' (Big-O notation)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Ne' when it begins a word like Neural, Neumann or Neuronal, mostly inside title-like text. It is silent on ' Ne' in 'Neutron'. Also fires weakly on 'elling'.
result.label: ' Ne' piece before 'ural/umann'

result.description: Fires mostly on " along" after a noun in technical or scientific text (e.g. "quantity along the curve", "sediment along the coast"). It also fires weakly on scattered other tokens. Logits are mixed and unclear.
result.label: ' along' in technical text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'end' in comm-end-ation, 'im' in Ferr-im-agnetism, and 'od' or 'ens' in similar split words. It needs a longer word that is still being spelled out. It is silent on 'end' in the name Brendon.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in long words

result.description: Fires on an incomplete word-stem piece (' confront', 'ile' in dilemmas, ' discuss', ' compreh') in abstract academic text, where the next token is a suffix like -ation or -ions that finishes the word.
result.label: Word stem awaiting suffix (confront-ation)

result.description: Fires on adjectives or adjective endings (conducive, specific, appropriate, -able, rich, needed) where a complement or "enough/than/-ness" could follow. Silent on 've' in other words (conveying, they've), so it depends on the adjective role.
result.label: Adjective ending awaiting complement

result.description: Fires on 'lies' in 're|lies' ("relies on"), after a subject like a field or discipline at the start of a document. Members detect rely/relied/relies forms, so it predicts "on".
result.label: "relies" verb piece 'lies'

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'medi' in "X-mediated" (cell-mediated, gravity-mediated), with weaker hits on other tokens like ' particular', 'ced', ' rates'. Silent on 'medi' in "intermediates".
result.label: 'medi' in -mediated compounds

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'wise' (pointwise, pairwise) and on ' hand' in 'on the other hand', plus weaker on adverb/suffix pieces like -worth, -eless. Seems to mark word-ending or discourse-adverb pieces that precede a modifier or contrast.
result.label: '-wise' suffix and 'other hand'

result.description: Fires on ' ensure' and similar verbs of providing or securing (' provides', ' enable', ' stabil-'), mostly when the verb follows a normal subject or purpose phrase. It stays silent on some ' ensure' tokens that follow a word run together with no space, as in "vergence ensure".
result.label: ensure / provide verbs

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments such as " termin" (terminology, terminates), and on "based" after "cloud-", plus a few other word pieces. These are pieces that need a suffix such as "-ology" to complete the word. Mixed evidence; peaks are inconsistent.
result.label: ' termin' and 'cloud-based' word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ip' inside words like Equipment, viviparous and Hip-hop. It also fires more weakly on ' Card', ' Set' and ' card' at the start of a term. Predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: 'ip' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of proper names and rare or foreign words (' York', 'Moh-awk', 'Mon-tero', 'Mag-gio', Cyrillic 'ности'), mostly where a name or word is incomplete. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Mid-word name fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece " mus" when it begins "muscle(s)", mostly in anatomy text about muscle types, and predicts "cle/cles". Weaker on "in" in "confinement" and a few other word starts.
result.label: ' mus' start of muscle

result.description: Fires on plural count nouns naming technical items or categories (branches, processes, classes, groups, records, frames), mostly in computing text, when used as the subject or object of a clause. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Plural technical collection nouns

result.description: Fires on a comma that follows a sentence-ending period, so the comma starts a new sentence, often lowercase. It stays quiet on ordinary mid-sentence commas, such as list commas or commas after clause openers.
result.label: Comma right after a period

result.description: Fires on ' toler' (tolerance) and the 'ance' ending of words like reliance, in business/technical prose. Mostly the word-start piece ' toler' that precedes 'ance'; the members detect ' toler' and '-ance' pieces.
result.label: toler- / -ance word pieces
Differential Equations title 'iffer'
result.description: Fires on the 'iffer' piece in capitalized "Differential Equations" titles or headings, especially at document start. It stays silent on lowercase "differential equations" in running prose.

Fires on the noun " identification", mostly right after "the" as the head of a nominal phrase (e.g. "the identification of risks"). Silent on the verb form "identifying". Members are mostly identification/detection/recognition detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: noun "identification" after "the"

result.description: Fires on " often" (also "sometimes", "utter") as a frequency adverb right after a subject noun phrase, before the main verb (e.g. "design often includes"). Silent when "often" follows "were/is" or "Though".
result.label: Frequency adverb "often" after subject

result.description: Fires on the plural nouns ' computers' and ' machines' (also 'factories'), mostly as the head noun after a modifier like personal, quantum, classical, or traditional. Silent on 'computer science'.
result.label: computers / machines plural noun

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-start piece ' del' (as in "delicate"), and also on ' incomplete', 'complete' and ' Deep'. Members are mostly ' del' token detectors from earlier layers. Weaker on "delicacies" and "Delphi".
result.label: ' del' piece of "delicate"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'enn' in Penn/Venn, 'or' in absorbing/absorption, and 'up' in follow-up, where a word is still unfinished. It stays silent on 'or' in 'tailor'. Evidence is mixed, with a low consistency of 38%.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: enn, or, up

result.description: Fires on word pieces in title or heading-like text at the start of a document, mainly 'chni' in "Techniques" and ' Background', plus a few other mid-word pieces. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Heading word pieces: Techniques, Background

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like " Lip"/" lip" (lipase), " equilib", " sol" in science/chemistry/biochemistry text, usually mid-word where the next piece completes a technical term. Members are mostly word-piece and chemistry detectors.
result.label: Technical word-start fragments (Lip, equilib, sol)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' acc' (start of "accent") in linguistics text, and weakly on ' subject' and ' object'. Members are detectors of acc/inc/sc word-beginnings plus grammar and language vocabulary.
result.label: ' acc' in accent (linguistics)

result.description: Fires on abstract head nouns (terms, case, context, level, form, domain, course) right after "in/at the" and before "of", as in "in terms of" or "in the context of". Silent in plain descriptive text.
result.label: Abstract noun before "of" (in terms of)

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract action or process noun (distribution of, arrangement of, application of, study of), predicting a following object noun like data or communication. Silent on some ' of' after similar nouns, so the cause is unclear.
result.label: ' of' after process nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ert' inside words like exert/exerted/inertial, and on ' of' after 'pair' (also group/set of). Silent on 'ert' in 'fingertips'. Mostly science-style text.
result.label: 'ert' in exert; 'pair of'

result.description: Fires on word pieces that mark a part of a period or an ordering, mainly ' latter' (the latter half) and 'colon'/'ital' inside post-colonial or revitalization. It also fires weakly on 'Early'. Mixed tokens, so the pattern is loose.
result.label: 'latter' and period-part word pieces

result.description: Fires inside "ratio of the ..." / "degree or duration of ..." phrases in science text, peaking on word pieces like "incidence", "sound", "the" after "ratio of". Predicts quantity-like continuations (required, total, quantity).
result.label: Quantity/ratio "of" phrases in science

result.description: Fires on abstract extent nouns like " scope", " course" (as in "over the course of") and " depth", usually after "the" and before "of". Contrast silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly detectors of these tokens.
result.label: scope/course/depth noun before "of"

result.description: Fires mainly on " Carlo" in "Monte Carlo" (methods, simulation, algorithms), with weaker firing on " computational" in numerical/simulation text. Members detect Carlo and simulation/numerical-methods words.
result.label: Monte Carlo (Carlo token)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Conf" (capitalized), mostly in heading-like text such as "Conflict Development" or "External Conflict", where it is the first piece of "Conflict". It predicts continuations like "lict".
result.label: " Conf" start of Conflict

result.description: Fires on the document-start/boundary token (shown as ¶) when it follows a short list-like line of topic headings (e.g. "Volcanoes. Earthquakes."), at the start of the next heading. Silent on the start token in some other contexts, such as prose openings.
result.label: Boundary token after topic-list headings

result.description: Fires on the middle word piece 'or' or 'hor' inside "rhetoric/rhetorical" and "metaphor/metaphoric", where a suffix like -ic or -ical is expected next. Weaker on similar mid-word pieces such as "stylistic".
result.label: Mid-word 'or' in rhetoric/metaphor

result.description: Fires on function words and modifiers (' the', ' a', ' our', '-', ' as') in astronomy/stars text, especially before a noun describing a stellar or physical object. Silent on ' the' in physics/chemistry phrases like "in the context of". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Determiners in astronomy text

result.description: Fires on the word-initial token ' A' / ' An' (e.g. 'An' of 'Ancient', matrix 'A', 'A' in AI), where the next piece continues a word or name. Silent on 'A' inside 'AAS' after 'within'. Logits are mixed.
result.label: Capital A / An token

result.description: Fires on the capital letter "N" (mostly inside acronyms like miRNAs, NMR, NLP) where it begins or sits inside an all-caps abbreviation. It is strongest in RNA-type words and in "NMR".
result.label: Capital N in acronyms

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sed' that begins "sediment(s)/sedimentology" in earth-science text, predicting 'iments'/'iment'. Weakly fires on 'oph' in "sophisticated". Members are detectors of ' sed', ' foss' and geology-related pieces.
result.label: ' sed' start of sediment

result.description: Fires on the words "Material"/"material" and on "liquid"/"fluid", mostly in science and engineering text (materials science, physical states). Members are mainly detectors of the token "material(s)", with a few for "fluid" and "liquid". Logits are not clear.
result.label: material / liquid / fluid words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Cal" at the start of a name, mostly in "John Calvin" (also Calvinist), where the next piece is expected to complete the name. Weakly fires on other split name or word beginnings.
result.label: Cal- in Calvin

result.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment (mostly 'cer', also 'h', 'l', 'bon') inside a longer split-up word such as sincerity, ulcer, carbohydrates, coulometry. It needs the word to be spelled in pieces and predicts a continuation fragment.
result.label: Mid-word fragment 'cer' in split words

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start or continue compounds: 'ogether' (sentence-initial "Together,"), hyphen after "sea", and ' rece' in "receivers". Mixed pieces; members detect 'together', hyphens, and sea-related pieces.
result.label: Compound pieces: ogether, sea-, rece
Mid-word fragments 'unct' in conjunctive
result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'unct' in "conjunctive"/"disjunctive", also 'os' in "presuppositions" and 'look' in "overlooked". It fires on an incomplete word that is continuing, in grammar and logic text.

Fires on the token " dialect" (including before suffixes like -s or -al) in linguistics text about language variation and dialect continua. Members are mostly detectors of "dialect" and related pieces. It is silent on general communication text.
result.label: ' dialect' token detector

result.description: Fires on the document-start token (<s>) when it appears right after a sentence-ending period in concatenated text, i.e. a new document or list item beginning after a short title-like sentence. It is silent on some other start tokens.
result.label: Document-start token after period

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ang' inside "entangled/entanglement" after "ent", predicting "lement". It stays silent when 'ang' starts the word without the "ent" prefix. Weakly fires on 'rop'/'hal' after "ent".
result.label: 'ang' in entanglement

result.description: Fires on noun-forming suffixes 'ance'/'ence'/'ness' completing words like "elegance" or "essence", mostly in abstract, mathematical-beauty prose. Silent on 'ance' in verbs like "enhance". Members detect elegance/beauty/symmetry words.
result.label: elegance/essence noun suffix

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ize/izes/izing" in "emphasize", after the "emphas" stem, where an abstract subject (theory, approach, perspective) is followed by an object like "the importance of". It stays silent on "ize" in "symbolize" and "prioritize".
result.label: emphas-ize suffix

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of long, rare words (Log-arith-mic, Babyl-oni-ans, Pyth-agoras, rhyth-ms, org-anoid), where the word is still unfinished and a suffix piece like 'mic' or 'ans' is expected next.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ological', 'tery', 'ING', 'en' and 'on' inside longer or split words. It is silent on 'ological' after 'bi'. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Mid-word suffix fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' character' (also 'character-' pieces) used as a modifier noun, as in "character development" or "character traits". It predicts continuations like ' development' and '-ize' suffixes. It is quiet on the contrast text.
result.label: ' character' as modifier noun

result.description: Fires on the underscore of a LaTeX/math subscript right after a variable (k_1, x_1, r_1, m_1), where an index like 1 or 2 comes next. Silent on a differently formatted polynomial example.
result.label: Subscript underscore after math variable

result.description: Fires on abstract action nouns and word pieces such as " use", " assigning", " allocation", " creation", " application" and "unct" (in punctuation). Silent on " use" when it follows an adjective or modifier, as in "correct use" or "advanced use". The members are mostly generic, so the evidence is weak.
result.label: Action nouns like use, allocation

result.description: Fires on the word " algorithm" (also "Algorithm"), mostly as a singular noun or stem before "-ic" as in "algorithmic". Its logits push towards suffixes like "ic" and "ically". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' algorithm' token detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece of biochemical compound names in metabolism text (oxaloacet-ATE, acetyl-Co-A, -ine), not on 'ate' as a verb ending like initiate or accelerate. Needs a biochemistry context.
result.label: Metabolite name endings (-ate, CoA)

result.description: Fires on the word " relative" (relative pronouns/clauses, relative motion or velocity), and occasionally on " dist" in words like distortion. Silent on "possessives" text without the token. Many members are " relative" token detectors.
result.label: ' relative' token detector

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' p' (the letter or a word-initial fragment like p-norm, prime p, pH, p-ausing), predicting continuations such as 'rag', 'unch', 'iv'. It stays silent when ' p' starts a word like 'pragmatist' at document start.
result.label: Lowercase ' p' token fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' Fourier' when it follows "of" in a phrase like "Background of Fourier Analysis" or "Concept of Fourier Transforms". It stays silent when 'Fourier' opens a document, so it needs preceding context.
result.label: ' Fourier' after 'of' mid-text

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns ending a noun phrase in linguistics or communication text (text, language, discourse, information, representation), where a comma or "and" often follows. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Language/communication noun heads

result.description: Peaks are scattered across unrelated tokens (' ten', ' own', '/', ' pairs', name fragments), often in grammar or possession text. No dominant token or clear condition. The circuit failed faithfulness, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and possession tokens

result.description: Fires on a mid-word piece (e.g. 'on', 'ens', 'ol') inside a longer word being spelled out or repeated, such as Decol-on-ization or Ath-ens. Often predicts a continuation suffix. Silent on 'on' in Pantheon or Organon.
result.label: Mid-word piece in multi-token words

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes inside longer words, mostly 'ic' in "stylistic", also 'me' in "permeated" and 'ge'. It stays quiet on 'ic' in words like Neoclassicism or mosaic, so it needs the specific host word.
result.label: Suffix piece 'ic' in stylistic

result.description: Fires on nouns naming a measurable physical property (color, weight, mass, size) in lists of material or chemical properties, especially after "molecular" or in property enumerations. Silent on generic technical prose.
result.label: Material property nouns (color, weight)

result.description: Fires on function words (the, of, like, and) inside lists of educational or historical institutions and developments, such as "institutions like the", "the rise of". Predicts academic nouns next. Silent on "the" in other contexts.
result.label: Function words before academic/institution nouns

result.description: Fires on the token ' acid' in chemistry text (acid-base, acidic strength, hydrochloric/citric acid). Predicts suffix continuations like 'ity', 'ic', '-'. Silent on cooking text about seasoning. Members are mostly acid-token detectors.
result.label: ' acid' token in chemistry

result.description: Fires on the 's' in decade plurals written with an apostrophe (1940's, late 1970'S) and on ' either' after a modal like "can either". It stays silent on possessive 's' and on decades without an apostrophe. The two triggers look unrelated.
result.label: Apostrophe decade 's and 'either'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words, mainly 'chni' in "Techniques" and 'ide' in "epidemics", also 'cont' in "subcontinent". Fragment is only active inside those particular words, in the middle of a split word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: Techniques, epidemics

result.description: Fires on word-initial pieces at the start of a longer word or number, mainly ' retro' (retrofit), ' pover' and the '2' in "Early 20th century". It seems to predict a word or number continuation. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-start fragments: retro, pover, 2(0th)

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "higher"/"high" (higher-order, high-energy) in technical or math text, plus a few word pieces like "ree" in degree and "ie" in Curie. Silent on hyphens after words like real, grid, term, complex.
result.label: Hyphen after "higher" compounds

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, such as ' bro' (broiler), ' tem' (temples), ' fert' (fertility), ' quart' and ' scalar'. It seems to anticipate a suffix continuation, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (bro, tem, fert)

result.description: Fires on " studies" (also " study") mainly in "case studies" and similar compounds like "observational studies", in academic or report-style text. Silent on "performance studies" as a field name. Weak extras on "or" in "rhetoric".
result.label: case studies
'ros' piece in neuroscience
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ros' mainly in 'neuroscience' (neu|ros|cience). The contrast text with 'neurophysiology' is silent. Members include 'ros' detectors from corrosion and microscope, so it is a token-level piece detector.

Fires on the plural noun " images" (mostly in image processing / computer vision text), with members detecting image/images/pictures tokens. Silent on the hyphenated "image-container" in the contrast.
result.label: ' images' token in imaging text

result.description: Fires on the plural word " humans", mostly as the object or subject noun after prepositions or comparisons like "like", "by", "between". Stays silent on the singular "human" in "human innovation".
result.label: Plural noun ' humans'
Sentence-ending period
result.description: Fires on a full stop that ends a sentence, heading or short title line (e.g. "Education and society."), where a new sentence or line comes next. Silent on periods in abbreviations like "B.C." and "i.e." or after list numbers.

Fires on the verb "help" and its forms (helping, helped, helps), mostly "helping" after "while also" or "by", in explanatory text. It predicts a following verb like understand, define or clarify. Members are detectors of help and assist.
result.label: help/helping verb before a verb
' dow' in downtime
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dow' that begins "downtime" (also "downturn"), mostly in IT or operations text. It is weakly active on ' portion' in "portion control". Members are mostly detectors of ' dow' and other word-start pieces.

Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "delivering" (also on ' deliver' itself). Silent on 'ing' in other verbs like responding or staying. Pushes toward delivery-related words such as delivered, delivery, services.
result.label: 'ing' in "delivering"

result.description: Fires on the token " method" (also "methods"/"Method"), especially where it could continue into "methodology/methodological". Logits boost "ologies", "ological", "ology". Upstream members are mostly " method" detectors.
result.label: ' method' predicting -ologies

result.description: Fires on word pieces in discussions of Hindu/Buddhist spiritual liberation (moksha, Samsara, Jnana, 'ultimate', 'liberation'). Silent on 'imate' in unrelated words like 'intimate' or 'underestimate'. Pushes toward Buddhist/spiritual terms such as Bud, Kar, Mah.
result.label: Spiritual liberation in Eastern religion

result.description: Fires on growth/development/expansion nouns, mostly right after "urban" (or economic, rural, sustainable), in urban planning and economics text. Silent on unrelated text like geometry. Members detect urban/city and development words.
result.label: Urban growth/development noun

result.description: Fires on the last word of a title-case topic heading in a list of course or subject headings (e.g. "Traffic Control Systems", "Group Communication Technology", "Economics Methods"). It is quiet on "Systems" in a physics heading.
result.label: Heading-final noun in topic lists

result.description: Fires on varied nouns ending a noun phrase in tech/AI and human-interaction text, most often ' vision' in "computer vision", also interaction, temperature, soundscapes. Weak, mixed evidence; the contrast is unrelated training text.
result.label: Computer vision and tech nouns

result.description: Fires on word pieces (e.g. -ential, -ization, -ing) completing multi-word entries in line-separated lists of academic subjects or course topics. It stays silent on the same piece in running prose or equation text.
result.label: Word endings in academic topic lists

result.description: Fires on ' that' as a relative pronoun right after a plural or abstract noun (e.g. "lessons that", "themes that"), introducing a clause that modifies the noun. Silent on complementizer 'that' after ensures, note, or such.
result.label: Relative 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires on ' analyt' (analytical/analytics) and on the 'or' in 'Kolmogorov', with weaker hits on ' widely'. It looks like a word-start piece predicting a suffix such as 'ical'. Evidence is mixed across these tokens.
result.label: analyt- and Kolmogorov 'or'

result.description: Fires on " cannot", mostly after a subject like "that", "externalities" or "energy" in expository economics or science text, where "be" often follows. Members are mostly detectors of "cannot" and negation words.
result.label: ' cannot' modal negation

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a surname (E in Euler, Sim in Simon/Siméon, Bern, F) after a first name in lists of mathematicians. It predicts the continuation of a famous mathematician's name, such as ö or Lap. It stays silent on non-mathematician names.
result.label: Mathematician surname first piece

result.description: Fires on the word " bounded" (as in boundedness, bounded operator, bounded growth), mostly in math or technical text. Weak activation on a few other word pieces such as "rained" and "ishing".
result.label: ' bounded' in math text

result.description: Fires mainly on " otherwise" in "an otherwise [adjective]" (also " overall", " else", and word-piece 'o'/'ic'), where an adverb modifies a following adjective. Mixed secondary peaks on word fragments.
result.label: "an otherwise" + adjective adverb

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'clusion' completing "Inclusion-Exclusion" (also "inclusion and exclusion"). Members are mostly 'clusion' and ' inclusion' detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: 'clusion' in Inclusion-Exclusion

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (eless, iring, " of", heart, "ground") in essay-style text about literature, nature and creativity, often in phrases like "source of", "inspiring", "fertile ground". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit is diffuse.
result.label: Inspiration/source phrases in creative essays

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " las" (and " Las") in "laser"/"lasers", predicting a suffix like "er" next. Members are mostly " las" detectors plus other word-fragment detectors (polym-, Bo-, ul-).
result.label: " las" piece of "laser"
