result.description: Fires on tokens right after a document-initial "Two" (e.g. "Two dominant", "Two-", "Two paradigms"), where the text is introducing a pair of things; also on "categories"/"distinct". Silent on hyphens in other words like "step-growth".
result.label: Words following opening "Two"

result.description: Fires on the completion of "decision making/makers" (tokens "making", "ers", " decision") after the word "decision", and weakly on nearby slots. Members detect "decision" and the hyphen in "decision-making".
result.label: decision-making / decision makers

result.description: Fires on the subscript or symbol token right after a capital "L" used as a math variable (e.g. the underscore in L_n, Lucas numbers). Members detect "L" followed by l/z/_/( characters. Weak firing on L at the start of words.
result.label: Subscript after math variable L

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, ' their', ' for', ' model', word fragments like 'min', 'ous') in technical or academic expository text. Peaks are scattered and silent on many commas. Circuit is weak and mixed, with no clear pattern.
result.label: Scattered tokens in technical prose

result.description: Fires on function words (the, to, their, being) that follow a verb or noun and precede an object noun phrase, in abstract academic text. Peaks are scattered and the contrast is unclear, so the pattern is weak and mixed.
result.label: Function words before object noun phrase

result.description: Fires on ' and' right after a name like "Martha Graham" in lists of people (dancers, artists), and on ' Graham' after "Martha". Silent on ' and' after other list items such as dates or parentheses.
result.label: 'and' after Graham in name lists

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Par' (also 'm' in Parmigiano), as in Parthenon, Parmenides, paradox. It needs the piece to begin a word that is still unfinished, with the ending predicted next; the contrast text has no such piece.
result.label: Par- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the "od" piece in split "flo|od" (also "oding", "plain" in floodplain), mainly in hydrology/flood-risk text. The same "od" in "Geodetic" is silent in contrast, so it needs the preceding "flo".
result.label: flood 'od' word piece

result.description: Fires on the 'FO' piece in the acronyms FIFO and LIFO (queue/stack ordering), mostly after 'FI' or 'LI'. Weakly fires on other acronym-initial pieces like 'LI' or 'LO' in acronyms.
result.label: FO in FIFO/LIFO acronyms

result.description: Fires on connectors (' and', ' for', comma) right after "mining" or "mineral(s)" in mining/mineral-resource text, as in "minerals and ores". Members detect min/mineral word pieces. Predicts mineral nouns like ' cer', ' foss'.
result.label: 'and' after mining/minerals

result.description: Fires on the piece 'om' when it follows 'bi' inside bio- words (biomaterials, biomass, biomimetic, biomolecule). It stays silent when 'om' starts a word.
result.label: 'om' after 'bi' in bio- words

result.description: Fires on 'power' as the piece after the prefix 'over' in 'overpowering' / 'overpowered'. Members detect 'over' plus word pieces (est, b, shadow) and 'power' itself. Weaker on 'overshadowed'.
result.label: 'power' in 'overpowering'

result.description: Fires on the token completing a word that follows "dry" (dry br-ush, dry punch-line, dry humor, dry-point). It stays silent on "brush" without a preceding "dry" (brushstroke, brushes).
result.label: Word completions after "dry"

result.description: Fires on mid-word or word-final pieces of technical or linguistic terms (e.g. 'lex', ' model' in "threat modeling", 'etic', '-ment'), where a suffix is expected next. Circuit fails and is diffuse; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in technical terms

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, often mid-word pieces or function words like ' and', ' to', ' FROM', in varied contexts. No coherent pattern; contrast also contains ' and' where it is silent. Evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Scattered mixed function-word and subword peaks

result.description: Fires weakly and diffusely on varied mid-sentence tokens (word pieces, function words, symbols) in lists and expository text. Peaks share no token or meaning, and members are generic token detectors. Evidence is too thin to say more.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token attention latent

result.description: Fires on the 'ation' ending of "appreciation", and weakly on the word after it (" and", " also", " the"). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as communication, innovation and reconciliation.
result.label: appreciation word-piece 'ation'

result.description: Fires on the token right after a form of "add" (e.g. "added to", "added in"), mostly ' to' following "added". Silent on ' to' after other words like "need", "used", "suited". Members detect "add/added/adding/additive".
result.label: Preposition after "added"

result.description: Fires on word pieces (-ing, -ive, 'the', 'a') inside the gerund or noun phrase right after the opening "When it comes to" at a document start. It stays silent on 'ing' elsewhere in mid-text.
result.label: Phrase after "When it comes to"
'prov' in thought-provoking
result.description: Fires on the piece 'prov' in "thought-provoking" (and similar "-provoking" compounds), with weaker activity on the following 'oking' or ' and'. Predicts continuations like choices or scenarios. Members are mostly generic.

Weak, diffuse attention latent firing on varied connective tokens (' and', ',', ' which') and noun-phrase endings in abstract essay-style text about culture and politics. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is poorly faithful.
result.label: Diffuse connectives in essay text

result.description: Fires on the word or piece right after "challenge/challenged/challenging" plus conventional/traditional, e.g. " traditional", " narr", " conception", in text about literary or artistic movements breaking norms. It stays silent on "traditional" in other constructions.
result.label: Challenging traditional norms, next word

result.description: Weak, scattered target firing on varied tokens (word endings like -ibility, -itive, verbs like contains/were, 'together', 'signed'). No clear shared token or context; members are generic token-level detectors. The circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and verb tokens

result.description: Fires on 'navigate' and its variants (navig-, navigating) and on the following words in the figurative phrase, such as 'through', 'the' or 'complex', as in "navigate the complex waters". Members are mostly navigate-token detectors.
result.label: navigate / navigating complex terrain

result.description: Weak, mixed attention-layer target firing on varied tokens: commas, word-start fragments (' st', ' tit', 'ing'), and abstract nouns like ' fundamental'. Evidence is thin and the circuit failed faithfulness; members are generic token detectors.
result.label: Mixed commas and word fragments

result.description: Fires on varied tokens ending abstract academic nouns or following them (expansion, -ment, -ism, 'of', 'in') in dense scholarly lists about social, economic or philosophical topics. Evidence is mixed and the circuit's faithfulness is poor.
result.label: Abstract academic noun endings

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (word pieces like 'asure', 'th', ' unique', ' are', ' Selection') in technical or list-like educational text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit fails faithfulness, so no clear trigger is visible.
result.label: Scattered mid-word pieces, technical text

result.description: Fires on the comma or "more" right after "furthermore" (also "further"/"more" in "further"/"moreover"-type additive transitions), where the text adds another point. Silent on ordinary commas in lists or after other connectives.
result.label: Comma after "furthermore"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, often word endings or mid-word pieces, plus ' ahead', ')', ' in' and ' by'. No clear shared meaning or construction. The circuit fails faithfulness and its members are mostly generic.
result.label: Scattered mixed-token attention latent

result.description: Weak, scattered target firing on varied tokens (' not' after "but", ' qual', commas, digits, ' the') within list-like or coordinated sequences. Circuit failed faithfulness; members are generic token detectors, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered list-position tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly verbs or word pieces in instructional or list-like text (' care' after 'they', ' apply' after 'then', 'ives', 'm'). No single token or construction dominates. Silent on 'great care'.
result.label: Scattered verbs in instructional text

result.description: Attention latent firing on varied word-ending or noun tokens (-ients, -es, writers, commas) in abstract expository prose, often a noun or verb ending a subject phrase. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Diffuse noun endings in expository prose

result.description: Attention latent firing on varied tokens (suffix pieces like 'ism', 'ious', list commas, 'and', 'on') inside abstract academic prose, often in lists of nouns. Peaks are scattered with low consistency; the evidence for a specific trigger is weak.
result.label: Scattered tokens in abstract academic lists

result.description: Attention latent firing weakly on varied mid-word and noun tokens (sites, societies, regions, adhering, concise) in academic text about language and culture. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is unfaithful, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered academic word-piece tokens

result.description: Fires on "Just" in the term "Just-In-Time" (inventory control) and on the hyphen right after it; weaker on other hyphens or "First". Silent on ordinary hyphens in compounds like "in-depth" or "decision-making".
result.label: Just-In-Time hyphen/Just

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "aspect" (also "component") in "X is a fundamental/crucial aspect of...". Silent on " of" after "web", "dozens", "preservation", or "much".
result.label: "of" after "aspect"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer words or names (Meg-ad-eth, Sh-ang-hai, mix-ing-redients, construct-ively), but stays quiet on 'ad' ending 'salad'. Weak, scattered circuit that fails faithfulness; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in split words

result.description: Fires on the word right after or inside the verb phrase following a plural subject plus "have" (e.g. "movements have progress-ively", "epics have capt-ivated", "have historically"). It marks the main-verb or adverb slot after "have" in abstract academic prose.
result.label: Verb or adverb slot after plural "have"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "quisition" at the end of "Inquisition" (the Spanish Inquisition). Members include detectors of "quisition" in "Acquisition" (language acquisition), so the piece is detected across words, but the target peaks on the Inquisition sense.
result.label: "quisition" in Inquisition

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' in', ' and', 'ency', ' systems', 'ics') inside abstract business, governance and risk-management prose. Peaks are mixed and the target is often silent on the same tokens, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Business/governance prose, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the comma right after a sentence-initial "...sequently" (a "Consequently,"-style opener at the start of a sentence). It stays silent on commas after "therefore" or "hence" mid-sentence and on list commas.
result.label: Comma after sentence-initial "sequently"
'ivity' in productivity/conductivity
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ivity' completing "productivity" (and weakly "conductivity"). It stays silent on 'ivity' in "connectivity" and "inclusivity", so it needs the specific preceding word piece, mostly "product".

Fires on varied tokens ending a technical noun phrase in science text, such as 'pressure' after 'temperature and', 'memory', 'phases', and 'chord-al'. It is inconsistent, silent on 'pressure' in some similar physics contexts, and the circuit is mostly generic.
result.label: Scientific noun-phrase completion, inconsistent

result.description: Fires on the verb or verb-start piece (' en' of enriched, 'ided' of aided, 'ed', 'enh') right after "greatly" in passive constructions like "greatly enriched/aided by". Silent on ' en' not following "greatly".
result.label: Verb piece after "greatly"

result.description: Fires on the word piece right after "very" (e.g. very s-ophisticated, very st-iff, very bl-urry), usually the first fragment of a split adjective. Silent on the same pieces after "more", "and" or "using", so it needs "very" directly before.
result.label: Word piece after "very"

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces ('ion', 'es', 'ive') inside the word "cohesion" and its relatives (cohesive, coherence, cohomology), after a split "coh"/"oh" start. Members detect the coh-/oh- fragment and its continuations.
result.label: Suffix piece inside "cohesion" words

result.description: Fires on the word right after "health and" (well-being, safeguard, nutrition), i.e. the second item of a "health and X" pair. Silent on "as well as" and "societal well-being". Circuit members are diffuse and weak.
result.label: Second item after "health and"

result.description: Fires on items in a list of "knowledge ..." terms (knowledge acquisition, knowledge representation), on the word piece or noun after "knowledge". Silent on "data acquisition", so it needs the knowledge-engineering list context. Members are mostly weak token detectors.
result.label: Knowledge acquisition/representation list items

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' to', 'ing', ' often', ' the', ' each') in expository text, mostly mid-phrase before a verb stem or suffix. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is unfaithful, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: Scattered function words, weak pattern

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens, mostly mid-phrase word pieces or nouns in academic or technical text (' language', ' to', 'ual', ' Ada', ' class'). The peaks share no single token or construction, and the circuit failed to reproduce the target well.
result.label: Scattered mid-phrase technical tokens

result.description: Fires on the word ' cell' (also ' cells', ' Cell') in biology text about cell membranes, walls and immune cells. It stays silent on 'cell' in an electrochemistry sense ('cell potential'). Members are mostly 'cell' token detectors.
result.label: biological 'cell' token

result.description: Fires on the last token of a noun or noun phrase (plural nouns like motifs, cues, technologies) in a list of abstract items, often where a conjunction or "such as" follows. Evidence is scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: End of plural noun in list

result.description: Fires on the word "physics"/"Physics", often after a modifier such as Particle, Nuclear, Atomic or Modern, or in lists of science fields. It stays silent on "Physical Chemistry" and other fields. Members detect physics and science-field words.
result.label: Physics word detector

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'to', 'universe', word pieces like 'ad' in Faraday) inside science and philosophy text. Peaks are scattered, consistency is low, and the same commas stay silent elsewhere, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered tokens in science/philosophy text

result.description: Fires on word pieces in magnification/optics text: "magnifying", "magnification" suffixes, "glass" in "magnifying glass", and "micro". It is silent on "ifying" in unrelated words such as "identifying". Members are optics, lens and imaging detectors.
result.label: Magnifying/magnification optics words

result.description: Attention latent firing on scattered tokens (' and', commas, ' vol', math factorial digits, mid-list words) with no dominant token or clear context. Members are diffuse token detectors; the circuit failed faithfulness, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Diffuse mixed-token attention latent

result.description: Attention-layer latent firing on the token after or within "generalization/generalizing" (e.g. "from", "(", "ge", "different"), carrying the word-generalize context forward. Members detect "general"/"-izations" pieces; silent on ordinary " to".
result.label: Tokens following "generalization" word

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ement' in "aforementioned", where it follows 'afor' and predicts 'ioned'. Members are mostly 'ement' detectors from early layers. Weak activation on other word pieces like 'apex' and 'henceforth'.
result.label: 'ement' in aforementioned

result.description: Fires on "communication" (or the "ation" ending of Communic-ation) right after "intercultural", in text about intercultural communication competence. Stays silent on "ation" in other words or in plain "Communication" without that cultural context.
result.label: communication after "intercultural"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens inside technical or business title-like phrases (e.g. "Relationship Management", "Memory Allocation Techniques", "Planned Maintenance Optimization ("), often the word after a topic noun. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Technical/business term phrase continuation

result.description: Weak, scattered target firing on varied tokens (periods, commas, ' and', word fragments) in garbled or fragmentary academic text. Members are generic token and word-piece detectors, and the circuit failed faithfulness, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered punctuation in garbled text

result.description: Fires on the word after or within "groundbreaking" (aking, work, studies, discovery, foundation) in academic text about research. It stays silent on "groundwork" in some contexts, so the evidence is mixed. Members detect the "bre"/"aking" pieces.
result.label: Groundbreaking research work continuation

result.description: Weak, scattered attention-layer target peaking on mixed tokens (' of', 'ation', '{', ' feature', LaTeX symbols) in science/math text. Circuit fails faithfulness; members are generic word-piece and topic detectors, so the pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered science/LaTeX tokens, unclear

result.description: Fires on the 'cular' piece of "Molecular" when it is split as Mole+cular, strongest at the start of a document or title, e.g. "Molecular Dynamics". It stays silent on mid-sentence lowercase 'mole'+'cular'.
result.label: Mole-cular at title start

result.description: Fires on the token right after "gut" (' health', ' h' of "hormones"), in digestive/gut-health text. Silent on ' h' in "hormonal" after other words like "involves" or "through". Weak activity on hyphens and other tokens.
result.label: Token after "gut" (health/hormones)

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' to', ' which', ' losses', 'oral', word fragments, ' of') in abstract academic prose, with no clear shared pattern. Members are generic context features; the circuit failed faithfulness and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered function-word and fragment peaks

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece "util" (and "iz"/"IT" pieces within it) in utilitarian, utilization, utilize, utilities, where more word pieces follow. Members are mostly detectors of the " util" token.
result.label: "util" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the first letter or piece after the prefix "inter" (m in intermolecular, c in intercultural, also dis, le, rog, qu), where a word continues. It stays silent on 'm' in other words such as paradigm or enigmatic.
result.label: Word piece after "inter" prefix

result.description: Diffuse attention target peaking on scattered function words and word pieces (' and', ' for', ' through', ' how', 'izing') in abstract expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is a failed fit with weak, generic members.
result.label: Scattered function-word peaks, unclear

result.description: Fires on varied mid-phrase tokens (word pieces like 'ulate', ' mel', ' my', and function words like ' and') in science/climate-style text, where a word continuation follows. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent; the evidence is thin.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and connective tokens

result.description: Fires on 'on' or 'to' in "based on" / "according to" / "depending on" when introducing the criterion for classifying or categorizing things. Silent on "based on" in non-classification contexts and on spatial 'on'.
result.label: Classification criterion: based on / according to

result.description: Fires on the 'on' piece inside "Spintronics" (Spintr-on-ics), in spintronics/quasiparticle physics text. It stays silent on 'on' in photon or phenomenon. Members detect 'on' after quasi-particle stems like phon-, plus spin- tokens.
result.label: 'on' in Spintronics

result.description: Fires on plural country words (" nations", " countries") right after "developed"/"developing" in economics text about development. Silent on "nations" without that preceding modifier or in other positions.
result.label: nations/countries after developed/developing

result.description: Fires on function words (' their', ' they', ' with', ' to') that follow a subordinating word like "since/as/so that" and start a clause whose verb is coming up. It stays silent on ' their' after "and" or as an object possessive. Predicts modal or verb continuations.
result.label: Clause-initial they/their after conjunction

result.description: Fires on ' from' that opens a range or spectrum ("from X to Y") after a list-introducing clause about variety, e.g. "come in all shapes and sizes, from simple...". Silent on 'from' meaning origin or source.
result.label: 'from' opening a range

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after "Min" in "Min-Max" (scaling), predicting the second half of the compound. Silent on hyphens in other compounds like trade-offs, large-dimensional, state-of-the-art.
result.label: Hyphen in Min-Max

result.description: Fires on the token right after "brain" (apostrophe of "brain's", hyphen in "brain-computer", " and", "imaging"). It is silent on apostrophes after other nouns. The circuit mixes punctuation detectors with brain/neuro context members.
result.label: Token following "brain"

result.description: Fires on verbs like "includes", "involves", "considers" that follow a relative "that/which" clause describing an approach or strategy (e.g. "a multifaceted approach that includes"). Predicts a list of components next.
result.label: Relative-clause "includes/involves" verb

result.description: Fires on the en dash '–' joining numbers in ranges, such as years (1874–1943) or numeric spans (13–14–15). It stays silent on dashes between letters or words, as in acid–base or P–n junction.
result.label: En dash in numeric ranges

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and punctuation (' that', ' the', ',', ' to', ' as') in dense technical or academic prose, but not consistently on the same token. Members are generic topic and token detectors, so the evidence is weak and mixed.
result.label: Scattered function words in technical prose

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings 'oms' in the heading "Idioms" (also 'aste' in "Waste") in list-like topic headings. Weaker on other mid-word pieces. Peaks inside specific words, not on a general meaning.
result.label: Idioms 'oms' / Waste 'aste' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word ' even' itself, mostly as an adjective (even number, even layer, evenly spread) and more weakly as the adverb 'even the most...'. Upstream members are mostly ' even' token detectors.
result.label: ' even' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-ending suffix pieces like 'ing' (lighting) and 'ness' (stillness), plus a few other tokens, mostly in art/media/tech text. Silent on many 'ing' endings of verbs, so it likes noun-like suffixes; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Noun suffixes -ing / -ness

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces that complete plural nouns (circ-uits, dev-ices, sens-ors, services) in technical text, plus a stray '0'. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low, so the pattern is weak and mixed.
result.label: Plural noun suffix pieces in technical text

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in regional/colonial-history text, such as ' Af' (African/Afro), 'ies' in Dutch East Indies, and 'w' in "underwent". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the circuit is weak.
result.label: Af-/Indies word pieces in colonial contexts

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer split words, mainly 'sten' in "sustenance", also 'c' in Mercator, ' Catal', 'ary'. Members detect specific word pieces (sten, pers, ited, ens, po) and predict suffix-like continuations such as 'ance'.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, esp. su-sten-ance

result.description: Fires on 'ing' word endings and similar gerund-like nouns (addressing, borrowing, rolling, feeding) right after "different/various/physical"-type modifiers, in a noun slot. Silent on many other 'ing' tokens, so the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Gerund noun after 'different' modifier

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ous' of "Continuous" when it completes the grammar tense name (Perfect Continuous, Present Continuous). It stays silent on 'ous' in other words like nebulous or synchronous.
result.label: 'ous' ending Continuous tense

result.description: Fires mainly on '0' in long runs of zeros (binary-like or decimal strings such as 0.000010100), and also on 'ent' in 'nutrient' and 'al'/'an' word pieces. It stays silent on '0' in ordinary numbers like 20 or 80%.
result.label: Zeros in long digit strings

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after a verb of perceiving or grasping (memorize, hearing, capturing, grasp the...), where an abstract object noun follows. Quiet on ' the' after prepositions like 'for' or 'to' before possessive nouns.
result.label: 'the' after perception/grasp verbs

result.description: Fires on 'hold' in share/stakeholder words and on ' fashion', plus occasional other tokens like ' intelligence' or ' wind'. Mixed peaks; members mostly detect 'hold' in shareholder/stakeholder. Weak, partial circuit.
result.label: hold in shareholder; fashion

result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word split into pieces (sens-, aud-, forec-, determ-, imag-) after an adjective like "personalized", "precise", "more", where the next piece completes the word. Silent on "sens" in "sensory feedback" after "and".
result.label: Word-initial fragment after adjective

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: ' of' after nouns like 'degrees' or 'fabric', word pieces such as 'olds' in 'Manifolds', and words like 'network' or 'overhead'. Peaks are inconsistent. It is silent on many other ' of' uses, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered ' of' and word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word "media"/"Media", most strongly as a capitalized heading-initial word like "Media Buying" or "Media Planning" at line start. Weaker for lowercase "digital media". Silent in "social media".
result.label: Media as heading word

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' absol' in "absolutes/absolutism", especially after "moral" or "ethical", and sometimes on ' worth' in philosophical text. It predicts word-completion pieces. Members detect word-start fragments.
result.label: ' absol' in philosophical absolutes

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and a few heading words like 'ving' in "evolving", ' surg', ' Bond', and 'oid' in "steroids". Peaks are scattered and weak, and the logits are mixed, so no single trigger or condition is clear.
result.label: Scattered word pieces: evolving, Bond, steroid

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: 'ary' in repeated "Literary ..." list headings, digits in number strings, and '=' slot before 0 in equations. Silent on 'ary' in other words. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Mixed: Literary list 'ary', digits

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or compound that is likely to continue into a technical term (exc|avating, well|bore, acid–base, meas|uring), but not on 'well' in 'as well as'. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Technical word-start fragments, not 'as well'

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emer' (start of emerged/emerges/emerging) when it follows a noun subject such as a movement, genre or technology that "came into being". It is quieter when the word starts a sentence or follows "to".
result.label: ' emer' as verb "emerged" after subject

result.description: Fires on ' in' right after a proper noun (place, country, organization) where a year is expected next, as in "Conference in London in 19…". Silent on ' in' after common nouns or verbs like "found in" or "shifts in".
result.label: ' in' after name, before year

result.description: Fires mainly on "In" in the acronym expansions "First-In, First-Out" / "Last-In, First-Out" (FIFO/LIFO), and secondarily on " after". Silent on unrelated text. Evidence is mixed beyond these two tokens.
result.label: "In" in First-In/Last-In; " after"

result.description: Fires mostly on long runs of dash characters (separator lines, often at document start or after a paragraph), and weakly on word pieces like 'omet' in 'organometallic'. Evidence is mixed beyond the dash runs.
result.label: Long dash separator runs

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments mid-word, mainly 'clar' (as in clarification) and 'rac' in Terracotta, where a suffix such as -ification or -otta is expected. Members detect other word-start pieces (authentic, ctu, trans, Ke).
result.label: 'clar' / 'rac' word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on past-participle or adjective forms (-ured, detailed, included, defined, described) that follow an adverb or auxiliary in academic or technical prose. Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak, with many shared members.
result.label: Participles in academic descriptive prose

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ersion' in "immersion" and 'al' in "focal", with weaker firing on ' its' and similar. Members detect these specific word pieces (imm-ersion, foc-al).
result.label: immersion / focal word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'e' right after the prefix 'macro' (macro|economics, macro|economic). It is silent on 'e' after 'socio' or 'Bio', or at the start of a word. Members detect scale prefixes like macro/micro/Mac.
result.label: 'e' after 'macro' prefix

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and noun slots inside academic or technical terms (ism, ology, ferromagnetism, homogeneity, software, collection), often in math, science or philosophy text. It is silent on 'ism' in some -ism words such as realism and nationalism.
result.label: Academic term word-pieces, mixed

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments of longer words, mainly ' acc' (as in accents) and 'grad' (as in degradation), where a suffix is expected to complete the word. Members detect these fragments, plus similar ones like sc, pot, oscill, val.
result.label: Word-start fragments acc/grad

result.description: Fires on single digit tokens (2, 3, 4, 5, 8) inside long runs of digits, such as number sequences or lists. It stays silent on digits within years like 1830s or 1923, which are in ordinary prose.
result.label: Digits inside long number strings

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'ological' and 'cial' (Gla-cial) in earth-science text such as geology, glaciers and geomorphology. It stays silent on 'ological' in meteorological, biological, or geological contexts at other positions, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Earth-science word endings (ological, cial)

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized title-style word or heading (' List' in "Listening", ' Network', 'ayer', 'row') in title-cased lists of topics, where a word continues into a suffix. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Title-case word-start before suffix

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "light" (light-dependent, light-emitting, light-year) and on suffixes like "-ism" in bilingualism, completing a compound or word. Silent on hyphens after other words (three-, wave-, ladder-).
result.label: Hyphen after "light"; -ism suffix
' Public' at list-item heading start
result.description: Fires mostly on ' Public' starting a new topic line in a list of academic or economics subject headings (e.g. "Public Sector Size"). Also weakly fires on word pieces like 'ur' and 'RAM'. Evidence is mixed.

Fires on the word " about" as a preposition after nouns or verbs of discussion or topic (conversation about, educating about, more about, concerns about). Members are mostly earlier-layer detectors of " about" itself.
result.label: ' about' preposition detector

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces completing a noun after "green" or sustainability words (green chemistry, green economies, green technologies, futures). Silent on "chemistry" in ordinary science contexts. Members detect recycling/waste/green vocabulary.
result.label: Green/sustainability compound noun endings

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Sem" (as in Semantic/Semantics), mostly at the start of a document or heading. It is weaker on " of" in "array of" or "range of". Members detect Sem/sem and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' Sem' word-start piece (Semantics)

result.description: Fires on the digit '2' (occasionally 3, 4, 6) in the middle or end of long digit strings and numeric codes. It stays silent on '2' at the start of a year such as 2000 or 2005.
result.label: Digit '2' inside long numbers
Word-fragment ' ill' in 'illusion'
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly ' ill' before "-usion" (illusion), also 'it' in pituitary and similar pieces of longer split words. It predicts word continuations such as 'usion' or 'umin'.

Fires on the verb "create" and its forms, mainly " creating" and " create", where a thing is being made (menus, images, art). Members are detectors of create/creating tokens. Predicts a following object noun or adjective.
result.label: create/creating verb

result.description: Fires on name pieces (surnames, first names, name fragments) inside lists of people's names, one per line. Peaks are varied (Johnson, Marg, Oscar, H), with a few weak non-name hits. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Name pieces in person-name lists

result.description: Fires on varied mid-word pieces and symbols (hyphen in a math formula, ' Polit', 'dis', 'archy', digits) in academic or list-like text, often where a word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. No single token dominates; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed word-fragment tokens in academic text

result.description: Fires on the word piece "in" inside split words like "conf-in-ement" and "tropon-in". It stays quiet on "in" in other words such as Gaugu-in, fasc-in-ating and prom-in-ence.
result.label: "in" piece in confinement

result.description: Fires on the comparative word " more" when it comes before an adjective, adverb or noun, as in "more efficient" or "more power". Members are mostly detectors of " more" itself. The contrast text has no " more".
result.label: comparative " more" before adjective

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ent' in "att-ent-ive/ively/iveness" (attentive, attentively), predicting the suffix 'ive'. Weaker firing on a few other pieces like ' to' and 'cer'.
result.label: 'ent' inside "attentive"

result.description: Fires on an early word fragment in the middle of a rare or multi-piece word (e.g. 'pi' in epistemic, ' My' in Mycenaean, 'sk' in skill), where the word is not yet complete. The next piece is a continuation, so it is a word-start detector for split words.
result.label: Word-initial fragments of split words

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'ant' (particip-ant, determin-ant, reson-ant), 'yp' in prototyping, 'ur' in slurry, and 'ery' in embroidery. It is strongest where a word is being completed, often 'particip-' words.
result.label: Word-ending pieces, esp. participant

result.description: Fires on the word "at" when it is quoted or discussed as a preposition (e.g. 'preposition "at" can indicate…'), and weakly on word pieces like Cub-, Col-, break-. Silent on "at" inside words such as versatility or Seurat.
result.label: Quoted preposition "at" in grammar talk

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of a compound or split word (line, coll-age, spect-acles, thread-ing) where the word is likely to continue with a suffix or hyphenated part. Mostly in art and culture text. Silent on 'in line with'.
result.label: Mid-word piece before suffix, art text

result.description: Fires on 'cial' in "facial" (not in "crucial"), and on a few other tokens like ' arithmetic', 'UI' and ' Menu'. Members detect facial/gesture/expression words, so it mainly tracks "facial" in nonverbal-communication text.
result.label: facial 'cial' piece (not crucial)

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ont" at the start of "ontology"/"ontological", predicting suffixes like -ology/-ological. Weak activity on similar word-start pieces such as "verte" and "tel".
result.label: "ont" piece of ontology

result.description: Fires on the last token of a noun-phrase item (e.g. 'scores', 'positioning', 'management', 'prediction') inside comma-separated lists of business or technical topics. It stays silent on 'ing' in verbs or 'marketing' within running text.
result.label: Final noun in topic lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'icle' in "wave-particle" (duality) and on 'verb' in "subject-verb" / "adverb", i.e. the end of a split technical word or hyphenated compound. Weak elsewhere on mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'icle' in particle, 'verb' pieces

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces inside longer, multi-token words, such as 'on' in 'Decolonization', 'ocrat' and 'overy' in 'Discovery', and on hyphens. It fires inside a word that is still unfinished, and is silent on 'on' inside other words (harmonies, phonologies).
result.label: Mid-word piece in split words

result.description: Fires on scattered words, such as " since", " or", " System", " recognized" and " Search", often in technical or list-like text. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit is diffuse, with no discriminative members. The pattern is unclear.
result.label: Scattered function and term tokens
' gr' word-start in grill words
result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' gr' when it begins a split word, mostly 'grill/grilling/grate' in barbecue text. It predicts a continuation like 'ills' or 'ated'. Weak activity on other word-start fragments such as 'aber', 'tit' and 'Conf'.

result.label: Word-piece 'int' in Monoprint
result.description: Fires mainly on the subword 'int' inside "Monoprint(ing)", and weakly on other mid-word pieces like 'yz' in catalyzing and 'ible' in indelible. It seems to need an unfinished word where the piece sits mid-word, in art/printmaking text.
Fires on the 'L' token completing "AVL" (as in AVL tree). It stays silent on 'L' when it starts a sentence or isn't preceded by "AV". Members are mostly 'L' detectors plus AV-context features.
result.label: 'L' in AVL tree
Suffix 'ic' in phenotypic/biology words
result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ic' ending a split technical word, especially biology terms like phenotyp-ic, and weakly on a few other suffix pieces. It stays silent on 'ic' in words like genomic, mosaic and intricacy.

Fires mostly on 'base' in "acid-base" chemistry text, and also on mid-word pieces like 'nis' in "omniscient" and 'ie' in "Trie". Members are mainly acid/base/pH chemistry detectors. The evidence is mixed.
result.label: acid-base 'base' plus word fragments

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments of long technical words (compat-, copolym-, flex-, invent-) where the word continues into a suffix like -ibility or -ers. Mostly science and technical text; peaks are mixed pieces.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of technical words

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "deep" (deep-frying, deep-fried) and on "der" in "Ladder", with weaker hits on other word-internal pieces. Members detect "deep" and hyphens. Other hyphens (all-out, lipid-rich, non-) leave it silent.
result.label: Hyphen after "deep"; Ladder

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' stir' (stir-fry, stirring) and ' quot' (quotation), plus a few similar word-start fragments like 'vers' and 'position'. It fires on incomplete word beginnings that are expected to continue into a longer word.
result.label: stir / quot word-start pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing "neighbor/neighbour" in "neighboring" (countries, nations, societies). It stays silent on "ing" in other verbs like "adhering" or "affecting".
result.label: "ing" in "neighboring"

result.description: Fires on 'ph' inside lymph-type biology words (lym-ph-atic, hydro-ph-obic) and on ' So' at the start of a document ("Soil ..."). Silent on 'ph' in macrophage. Peaks mix word pieces rather than one token.
result.label: 'ph' in lymph words; initial 'So'

result.description: Fires on varied word-piece tokens (e.g. 'atic', repeated '0', 'chy', 'oney') in technical or academic text, often after linguistic or scientific terms. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent, and it is silent on 'atic' in enigmatic/operatic.
result.label: Scattered word pieces in technical text

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that starts a second term in a short Title-Case list heading, mostly after "Customer" (Ret-ention, Communic-ation, Ac-quisition). Peaks on word-start fragments that are likely to continue into a longer word.
result.label: Word-start after "Customer" in heading lists

result.description: Fires on the token " at" / " At", both as the preposition (at all levels, at rest, at work) and as the start of "Atmospheric" at a heading. Silent on "look at" in one example.
result.label: " at" / " At" token detector

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a surname (Ber-keley, Fre-y, Bla-ke, Wol-fram) after a given first name in lists of writers, philosophers and artists. It predicts a surname continuation. Silent on lists of school subjects.
result.label: Surname start after first name

result.description: Fires on the middle piece 'igen' in "indigenous" (also 'ug' in subjugation, similar mid-word pieces) when it follows the "ind" prefix. Silent when 'igen' starts a word without "ind" before it.
result.label: 'igen' inside "indigenous"

result.description: Fires on the adjectives " sweet" and " weak" (also "strong"-like quality adjectives, weakly on "R" in qPCR) as modifiers before a noun, e.g. "weak bases", "sweet seared meat". Members are detectors of sweet, weak and strong.
result.label: sweet / weak adjective modifiers

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ow' (shallow, Bronsted-Lowry, vowel) and 'at' (chromatography), where a word is split into pieces. Members detect these specific pieces. The contrast 'allow' is silent, so it needs the word-internal position.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'ow' and 'at'

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and word starts such as 'plus' in surplus, ' Conserv', ' Seg', ' analy', where a longer word is being built up. Peaks are mixed, and the members detect surplus/excess word pieces.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, mainly surplus

result.description: Fires in LaTeX/math markup on opening math tokens such as ' \(' and '{' (e.g. \mathfrak{, subscripts) and on byte-fragment tokens inside formulas. Silent on plain prose. Members detect backslash/brace and math-word tokens.
result.label: LaTeX math delimiters and braces

result.description: Fires on word-start or mid-word pieces of a longer word or compound, such as Work in "Audio Workstation", Appro in "Approach", viol in "violin", and the suffix ive. It seems to predict the next piece that finishes the word. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Incomplete word fragment awaiting continuation

result.description: Fires on pieces inside ALL-CAPS text, such as ' IS', 'IT', ' HE', ' US', and mid-word fragments of capitalized words. Upstream members detect caps fragments like ' CON', 'ENT', 'CT'. Also fires weakly on LaTeX and underscore runs.
result.label: All-caps word fragments

result.description: Fires on mid-word or next-word tokens inside short academic or topic-list headings (e.g. "Language Testing", "Music Festival Genres", "Merchandise") and some abstract noun phrases like "social interactions". Peaks are scattered and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Topic-list heading continuation tokens

result.description: Fires on ' ticket' (esp. after "mobile" or in "ticketing") and on 'ver' in "adverbs"; both are word pieces that are often followed by a suffix such as -ing or -bs. Weak on a few other word stems.
result.label: ticket / ver word-stem pieces

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'cy' in "fallacy" (also "cies"), plus ' Web' in "Cosmic Web" and 'aire'. Mostly the final piece of a multi-token word; members detect fallacy-ending pieces.
result.label: Fallacy 'cy' word-ending pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " misunder" (before "standing/stood"), and less on " exclusive" after "mutually". Members detect "mis-" and "under" prefix pieces and other word-start fragments.
result.label: " misunder" word-piece before -stood

result.description: Fires on the first piece of an artist's name (Rap|hael, Rem|brandt, Al, Bar) in lists of famous painters, right after "artists like/such as" or "and". Needs art-history context; silent on general Renaissance text.
result.label: Painter name start in artist lists

result.description: Fires on varied word stems or pieces (' copying', ' document', 'on' in Decolonization, 'aking') that are mid-word or verb stems expecting a suffix like -ing/-ization. Peaks are mixed; the pattern is weak and low-consistency.
result.label: Verb stems awaiting suffix

result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: sentence-initial " When", word pieces like "ich" in Carmichael, "ti" in Bhakti, and " Path" in Eightfold Path. No single meaning is clear, and the contrast does not isolate a condition.
result.label: Mixed: When, name fragments, Path

result.description: Fires on ' it' (also ' of', ' they') right after a "not just / more than just / beyond mere" contrast, where the clause continues the point (e.g. "more than just a sum of", "imports more than it exports"). Silent on ordinary ' it' in other clauses.
result.label: 'it' after "more than just" contrasts

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside biochemistry abbreviations and terms, such as Co in acetyl-CoA, AD in NAD(P)+, and P in RuBP. It sits in metabolism text (ATP, Krebs, Calvin cycle) and predicts a suffix-like continuation.
result.label: Biochemical abbreviation fragments (CoA, NAD)

result.description: Fires on the word " multimedia", mostly as the object after verbs like incorporating, utilizing or integrating. Supported by members for media-related words (video, audio, interactive, Media). Silent on the contrast text about digital art.
result.label: ' multimedia' after incorporating verbs

result.description: Fires on the verb piece ' adopt' (adopting) and on 'ield' in 'wield'. Both are transitive verbs of taking up or using something (a practice, power). Members are token detectors for adopt and ield.
result.label: adopt / wield verb pieces

result.description: Fires on the conjunctions ' or' and ' and' joining items in economics or monetary and fiscal policy text, such as government spending or tax reductions. It stays quiet on 'or' in other lists, such as ' fixed or variable' and 'economics, or'.
result.label: Conjunctions in economic policy lists

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: the digit '5' inside long digit strings, hyphens, and fragments of Devanagari/Arabic multi-byte characters. Silent on '5' in ordinary years or decimals. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Digit 5 in digit strings, byte fragments

result.description: Fires on the modifier words " online" and " digital" (also "virtual", "electronic") before a noun like platforms, genres, or age, mostly in text about media and communication. Members detect these words and related platform names.
result.label: online/digital modifier before nouns

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary verb (' are', also ' been', ' being', ' have') right after a plural subject noun phrase like "Several different types" or "Many methods", near document start. Stays silent after pronouns or relative "which/they are".
result.label: Are after quantified plural subject

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ch' in "etching" (et-ch), and 'ot' in words like "pluripotent"/"totipotent". It is silent on 'ch' in "bench" or a bare "ching" at sentence start. Needs a specific word-piece context.
result.label: Word-piece 'ch'/'ot' in etching, -potent

result.description: Fires on measurable-quantity nouns such as level, size, density, content, mostly after a property noun in technical or scientific text (particle size, moisture content level, sample size). Weak on similar nouns like states or points.
result.label: Measurable quantity nouns in technical text
List items in abstract noun series
result.description: Fires on a list item or comma inside a series of abstract or technical nouns (e.g. "breeding, reproduction, or sampling"; "transparency, privacy"), where another list item is expected. Silent on commas outside such enumerations.

Fires on a mix of tokens: ' secondary' most often, also ' Lie' (Lie algebras/brackets), 'fol' (folding), and word pieces like 'ory'. Members detect 'primary'/'secondary' pairs, but the other peaks share no clear link.
result.label: secondary / Lie / mixed word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'in' inside the name "Bose-Einstein" (E-in-stein), plus scattered other tokens (' Lucas', ' Sea', ' half'). Silent on 'in' in words like fascinating, vein, refinement.
result.label: 'in' inside Einstein

result.description: Fires on determiners or quantifiers (an, a, some, any, either, both) right after the preposition "for", as in "for an infinite set". The same determiners after other verbs or prepositions leave it silent.
result.label: Determiner after "for"
' media' in "mixed media"
result.description: Fires on the token ' media' (also ' Media'), most strongly in "mixed media" in art contexts. It fires only weakly on "social media" or "enrich media". Members are mostly detectors of media/Media.

Fires on the digit '9' within multi-digit numbers, such as years like 1789 or long strings of nines and digits. It stays silent on '9' as the second digit of a 19xx century pattern (e.g., 1[9]th, 1[9]35).
result.label: Digit 9 in later number positions

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'atic' completing "chromatic" (chromatic aberration, Achromatic/Apochromatic lenses). Members detect chrom- word pieces like chromosome and chromatography. Silent on 'atic' in other words such as "noechaumatic".
result.label: 'atic' in chromatic

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, especially 'as' inside words like Plasmon or endoparasites, and on ' Error' in "Type I and Type II Errors". Silent on 'as' in quasi or seas. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Word-fragment 'as' and Error

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments or word pieces in multi-token words and names (mer-gers, Bron-te, Ant-it-rust, prepar-ation), plus some noun-phrase tokens. Peaks are scattered and inconsistent; evidence is weak and the circuit is unfaithful.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of split words

result.description: Fires mostly on " Latin" as a standalone word (Latin squares/rectangles, Classical Latin), with minor peaks on word pieces like "iction" and "ent". Silent on "Latin" in the hyphenated "Latin-speaking" at the text start.
result.label: Latin word token

result.description: Fires on closing braces like '}}' and '!}' at the end of LaTeX fractions or square roots in math formulas, plus a few scattered tokens. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the pattern is weak.
result.label: LaTeX closing braces in formulas

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments early in a document or phrase, mainly 'fficient' in "Efficiently", also 'isson' in Poisson and ' Prof'. Appears to be mid-word pieces of efficiency-related or technical words; silent on repeated "Dr. Name" lists.
result.label: Word fragments: 'fficient', 'isson', Prof

result.description: Fires on the copula ' are' or ' is' right after a subject noun that is a technical or generic topic term (QC, JPEGs, standards, functions), in a definitional or general-statement slot. Quiet after 'there', after 'and', or when the verb is a progressive.
result.label: Copula after generic technical subject

result.description: Fires on the piece 'atic' completing "dramatic" (mostly in arts/theatre text), with a few other word-piece completions like Man-if-esto. Silent on 'atic' in "operatic" and in an odd "ram-atic" fragment.
result.label: 'atic' in "dramatic"

result.description: Fires on plural abstract content nouns like points, ideas, details, as objects of study or note-taking verbs (highlighting key points, summarizing ideas, filtering details). Appears in learning, communication and presentation text. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Key points/ideas/details as objects

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ome' in "genome" (also weaker on 'et' in "genetics" and 'IS' in CRISPR), in genetics and biotech text. Silent on the full word "genetic" in the contrast text.
result.label: 'ome' piece of genome

result.description: Fires on the word or token right after the modal "may" or "might" (suggest, be, use, require, choose to, have), where a hedged verb is expected. Silent on "pect" inside "perspectives". Fires in hedged descriptions of cultural and behavioural generalizations.
result.label: Verb slot after "may/might"

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (' can', ' to', ' arithmetic', commas) in text about CPUs, processors and computing operations. Peaks are inconsistent. It stays silent on ' can' in other technical contexts, so it seems tied to the CPU/computer-operations passage.
result.label: CPU operations passage, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ong' completing "Str|ong" (Strong Force, Strong Typing, Strong Authentication), also 'lish'. Silent on 'ong' without a preceding "Str" at the start. Members detect 'ong' and 'ateg'.
result.label: 'ong' after Str (Strong)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'vin' in "Calvin" (Calvinism, Calvinist, Calvin's). Weak activations on ' can' and ' may' are minor. Members are mostly 'vin' token detectors.
result.label: 'vin' in Calvin

result.description: Fires on tokens that precede or begin a date or era: ' Kingdom' after Old/New/Middle/Roman, and the start of year numbers like '1' in 1050 or 1800. It predicts a following date or 'around'. Mixed peaks, with the weaker contexts unrelated.
result.label: Kingdom and year-start tokens before dates

result.description: Fires on the token right after an adjective ending in -able/-ible (countable n-ouns, actionable out-comes, sustainable energy), where a noun or word continuation is expected. Silent after "used" in a similar slot.
result.label: Token after -able adjective

result.description: Fires on the word "magnet" and its variants (magnetic, magnet-, magnets), including word pieces like "magnet" in magnetosphere. Members are detectors of magnet/magnetic/electric tokens in physics text. It stayed silent on one text-initial " magnetic".
result.label: magnet / magnetic token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mark' when it is the start of a split word, especially "markets" after a modifier (financial, money, bond, commodity). It is silent when "mark" opens the text or follows a verb like "stabilize".
result.label: ' mark' piece in compound "markets"

result.description: Fires on the first word piece of a split surname or rare name, mainly ' Bol' (Boltzmann), also ' Lap' (Laplace), ' Rad', ' Fre'. It sits where a continuation piece like 'tz' or 'lace' is expected next.
result.label: Name-initial fragments: Bol, Lap

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece ' imp' when it starts "implications"/"implication", and also on 'LP' in "NLP". Predicts a continuation like 'lications'. Members are mostly ' imp' detectors.
result.label: ' imp' before 'lications'

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ins' when it is the start of a longer word such as insurance, insights or inscribed, mid-sentence. It is silent when ' ins' begins the document or text.
result.label: ' ins' word-start piece (insurance/insights)

result.description: Fires on ' Dr' at the start of a line in a list of names, where each line is a "Dr. Surname." entry following earlier "Dr. Surname." lines. Silent on lists of plain names without a title.
result.label: Repeated ' Dr' in name lists

result.description: Fires on incomplete word stems of long Latinate words (anticip-, optim-, recogn-, accur-) that are followed by a suffix like -ate, -izing, -ately. Seems to mark a mid-word stem awaiting its ending.
result.label: Latinate word stems (anticip-, optim-, accur-)

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside biology/microbiology terms, mainly 'og' in "pathogens" and 'ial' in "bacterial", in scientific text about infection and immunity. Silent on casual conversational text.
result.label: pathogen/bacterial word pieces

result.description: Fires on function words (of, that, and, B, are) right after the word "events"/"Event" in probability text about mutually exclusive events. Predicts event-related continuations like happening/occur. Silent on "of" after other nouns.
result.label: Function word after "events"

result.description: Fires on a period that follows a single initial or short fragment inside a name, abbreviation, or number (H.P., S.V., 2.1, U.S.S.R.), not on sentence-ending periods. Next-token logits favor single letters.
result.label: Period after initials or abbreviations

result.description: Fires on manner or frequency adverbs (easily, quickly, often, always) placed between a modal or auxiliary and its main verb, as in "can easily", "can quickly". It predicts a base verb next. It is silent on "carefully" after a verb.
result.label: Adverb after modal, before verb

result.description: Fires on the 'bs' piece of "Adverbs" when it starts a document or heading in English grammar text (e.g. "Adverbs of manner"). Members are grammar-topic detectors (clause, past, plural) plus 'bs' detectors.
result.label: 'bs' in "Adverbs" grammar heading

result.description: Fires on structural-noun tokens like " stack", " ring", " shell" used as technical terms (electron shell, algebraic ring, stack in computing). Predicts nothing clear; members are per-token detectors for stack, ring, shell, table.
result.label: Technical structure nouns: stack, ring, shell

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of longer words, mostly 'cel' in porcelain, also 'lex' in reflexively and 'las' in cytoplasmic. Predicts word-completing suffixes like -ium, -ion, -atori.
result.label: Mid-word 'cel'/'lex' fragments

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: ' wet' in "wet-on-wet" painting, 'Europe' in Indo-European, and 'ake' in "stakeholder". Mixed, polysemantic target; members are mostly language/word-piece detectors.
result.label: wet / Indo-Europe / stakeholder pieces
Hyphen in Sapir-Whorf style compounds
result.description: Fires mainly on the hyphen in the name compound "Sapir-Whorf" (also Scytho-Sarmatian), plus some word-ending pieces like -atic/-ates. Silent on hyphens in Indo-European, pre-Socratic or human-environment. Seems to need a hyphen joining two surnames or ethnonyms.
Fires mostly on " order", especially in the sentence-opening "In order to" purpose phrase. It also fires weakly on modal-like words such as " can" and " would". Many members are " order" detectors.
result.label: " order" in "In order to"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments completing a word, mostly 'itative' in "qualitative", also 'ze' in "breeze" and 'p' in "Streep". Silent on "quantitative", so it seems to need the "qual-" prefix. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Word-ending fragments, esp. qual-itative

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'e' in "Appeal", 'ts' in "experts", and 'ient' in "experiential". It peaks on the 'e' of "Appeal" in headings. It looks like a word-piece completion latent, and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments (App-e-al, expert-s)

result.description: Fires on the en dash '–' used as a separator in chains of ranges or lists (years, numbers, country pairs like Austria-Hungary–Russia–). Needs a dash that continues a sequence of items; quiet elsewhere.
result.label: En dash in range/list chains

result.description: Fires on word pieces in phonetics/linguistics text about vowels and consonants (vowel, vowels, "sounds" after vowel, consonants), predicting sound/phon-type continuations. Silent in general language text without phonetics.
result.label: Vowel/consonant phonetics terms

result.description: Fires on commas and conjunctions ("and", "or") that continue a list of abstract nouns or items (e.g. "strength, power, safety, comfort,"), plus "and" inside hyphenated compounds. Silent on clause-level commas.
result.label: List-continuation commas and "and"

result.description: Fires on an incomplete word-start fragment (Tre, Pl, Se, imp) in a title-case heading or title, where the next piece completes the word (Trees, Planning, Seas, implications). Logits favor suffix pieces.
result.label: Word-start fragment in titles

result.description: Fires on ' musical' (also -ic/-omic endings) when it modifies a following noun like "notation", as in "musical notation systems". It stays silent on ' musical' after "their", "wider" or "sharing". Evidence for the exact condition is thin.
result.label: ' musical' before technical noun
' ste' word-start before 'ering'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ste' when it starts a split word, mostly 'steering' (adaptive/electric/power steering). Members are mostly ' ste' detectors. It weakly fires on similar word-start fragments.

Fires on mid-name word pieces in a person's name, especially first-name or surname fragments (Hay, von, Ort, Sab, Emil, Bren) in lists of famous scientists, and on odd Arabic or garbled-byte pieces. Predicts surname continuations such as ' von'.
result.label: Partial surnames in scientist name lists

result.description: Fires on commas and other connectors (' by', ' or', ' in', apostrophes) that follow a noun in expository lists or enumerations, but is silent on many commas before participial clauses. The pattern is mixed and the evidence is thin.
result.label: Commas and connectors in enumerations
Mixed: ' common', 'en' in Phen-, prime mark
result.description: Fires on a mix of tokens: ' common' (and ' proper' in grammar contexts), the 'en'/'on' piece inside words like Phenomenology and Phonetics, and the prime mark in coordinates. No single clear shared role.

Fires on ' median' and on 'omed' in repeated "Biomedical" course-title lists, with weaker firing on a few other words (' worst', ' north'). Members are statistics/math word detectors (mean, variance, median). Peaks are mixed and the circuit is weak.

result.description: Fires on scattered, rare word pieces: fragments of non-Latin scripts (Arabic, Thai, byte pieces), ' Besch', ' wy', 'buf', 'overline'. Peaks are inconsistent. The members are mostly token detectors for odd fragments, so the pattern is diffuse and weak.

'zym' inside 'enzyme'

Fires mainly on the word piece 'ess' mid-word (Hess-ian, chess, non-ess-ential, tenderness), plus other mid-word fragments like ' dict', ' perpet', ' gover'. Seems to expect a continuation like 'ential'. Mixed and weak peaks.

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' intermediate', Cyrillic pieces, and mid-word Arabic letters, plus weakly on ' other'. Predicts plural noun continuations such as alternatives, ones, options. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.

result.description: Fires mainly on " Big" in "Big O" notation lists in computer-science asymptotic analysis text. Weak activity on a few other word-start pieces (etra, cardinal, mic). Silent in unrelated math text.
result.label: "Big" in Big O notation

result.description: Fires on the piece 'vin' in the name Calvin (Calvinism, Calvin's), and occasionally 'ford'. Members are mostly 'vin' detectors plus a ' Cal' detector, so it needs the preceding Cal- piece.

result.description: Fires on word-initial or mid-word fragments such as ' c' (cement, cake), 'pect' in "Respect", 'ym' in "Polymer", and 'rag'. It seems to predict a word continuation. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.

result.description: Fires mostly on word-start fragments ' ec' (ecotox-, ecstatic) and ' intr' (intricate), plus some Arabic letters and punctuation. Members are mostly detectors of word-piece fragments at the start of a longer word.

result.description: Fires on the token " LED" (also "LED"), mainly in display-technology lists such as Quantum Dot LED, OLED, QLED. Weaker on a few word pieces like "omorphic". Members are mostly LED token detectors.

result.description: Fires on the word or piece right after "serve(s)/serving/act as / function as", where the complement noun (both, an example, emblems, mirrors, guides) begins. Peaks are scattered across tokens; the construction is what matters.

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('us' in ethnomusicological, 'ene' in Hermeneutic, ' Res' in Respect) where the word is incomplete and a suffix like 'ic', 'pect', 'an' should follow. Silent on 'us' in 'illusions'.

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of longer words, especially 'ry' in Tapestry/Symmetry/embryonic, 'ag' in Backpropagation, and word-initial ' Gen' or ' Po'. Seems to mark an incomplete word piece in academic text. The evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the word piece " caus" at the start of "causality" and "causal", mostly in philosophical or analytical text. It predicts suffixes like "ality", "ities" and "ity". Members are mostly " caus" detectors in earlier layers.

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (through, their, who, grow, 's, -ates) mid-sentence in explanatory text. Logits mildly suppress pronouns like their/they/them. Peaks are inconsistent and members are diffuse, so the evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' fra' (fractions, fraud) when it is split before its continuation, with weaker firing on other word-start pieces like ' redu', 'rop', 'ec'. It predicts a word-completing suffix.

result.description: Fires on a few different nouns that often start compounds or words: ' heart', ' height', ' pot' (melting pot), ' sou'. Peaks are mixed; members include height and heart token detectors. Logits are unclear.

result.description: Fires mainly on ' Plan' as the start of "Planck" (the physicist/satellite), and on a few other pieces like ' astronom' in science text. Predicts "ck" continuation. Silent on the contrast's cosmology text without that name.

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments after a prefix like pre-/pred-/Hyp-, e.g. 'oth' in Hypothesis, 'erm' in predetermined, 'et'/'os'. It is silent on 'erm' in undermine, so it needs the pre-/hypo- word context.

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' liter' (literacy), ' advoc' (advocate) and ' accum' (accumulate), where the next piece is likely a suffix such as 'acy' or 'ates'. Mostly the ' liter' stem.

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cub' (start of "cubic") in crystallography lattice lists, such as "body-centered cubic" or "face-centered cubic". Members detect ' cub', 'ic', and crystal or lattice context.

'ction' in "auction"

result.description: Peaks scatter across unrelated tokens (word fragments like 'ed', 'ary', ' MO', '/', 'world') mostly inside technical or academic text, mid-word or mid-compound. No coherent trigger or condition is visible; members are mixed token detectors.

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-piece " indust" (before "ries"), also on other incomplete word stems like " assemb", " Supp", "ing-red". It predicts a suffix continuation. It was silent on one sentence-initial "industries".

result.description: Fires on ' sensitive' (also ' safe') and on the piece 'mos' in "Atmospheric" at a document start. It looks like a mix of a sensitive-word detector and a word-piece case; the members mostly detect ' sensitive'.

result.description: Fires on Cyrillic word pieces (' у', 'ск', ' ар') inside garbled, scrambled pseudo-Russian text mixed into English. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic fragment detectors. Weak, mixed evidence.

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside technical or art words, mostly 'work' after 'art' (artwork, brushwork), also 'av' in concavity and 'ating/ations' in oscillating/oscillations. Silent on 'art' alone.

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: 'ions' ending "fermions" (not in "invasions" or "inventions"), and ' Africa' in colonial or geographic contexts. Mixed, polysemantic target; weak activations on other tokens.

result.description: Fires on a comma separating items in a list of nouns (e.g. "the heart, blood vessels", "argon, carbon dioxide"), mostly in the middle of enumerations in explanatory text. Silent on commas after introductory phrases like "for example," or "to understand this,".

result.description: Fires on a capitalized word-initial fragment that begins a longer word and is split across tokens (Ama in Amadeus, Per in Perfect, Poss, Luc). It seems to predict a continuation piece such as 'art', 'ren' or 'on'. Evidence is mixed.

result.description: Fires on the prefix tokens ' inter' and ' non' as standalone word-start pieces, mainly ' inter' beginning "intervention" or "interference". It stays silent on ' inter' in "intertwine", "inter-personal" and "interruption". Members are mostly weak token detectors.

result.description: Weak, scattered target firing on varied tokens (' and', ' the', word-piece fragments like 'Y', ' fighting', '-ing') in the middle of lists, math, and prose. Members are generic token detectors; no coherent pattern. Silent on ' and' in plain lists.

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word endings like 'ed', 'ist', 'vention', ' nuclear', ' North') in Cold War text that follows a mention of the Soviet Union. Members detect Soviet/Union, arms, Germany and military words. It stays silent on 'ed' in unrelated passages.

result.description: Diffuse attention-based latent peaking on varied tokens (' in', ' and', ' L', spaces, mid-word pieces) in academic expository text. Peaks are inconsistent and members are generic context, so the pattern is weak and mixed.

result.description: Weak, mixed circuit that fires on scattered tokens: ' and' in lists, ' of', and word-internal pieces (NO in AgNO3, OFF, Kit, agram). It fails faithfulness, and the contrast shows ' and' staying silent in other places, so the pattern is unclear.

result.description: Weak, mixed attention-layer target peaking on scattered tokens: ' not' after "but", ' general' in "in general", 'am' in "seamlessly", ' Robert'. Silent on many ' not' cases. Evidence is thin; the circuit failed faithfulness.

result.description: Fires weakly on varied tokens (' and', ' within', ' phrase', 'de', ' among') in abstract academic or writing-related prose, often after a noun where a coordinated or related noun follows. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed faithfulness.

result.description: Fires on function words (of, between, by, in, and, commas) right after the object noun of "addresses" in academic text, e.g. "addresses the interconnectivity of". Silent on ' of' after other nouns like "theory of" or "importance of".

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' for', ' as', ' service', 'ements', ' see') at points where a complement or continuation is expected. Peaks are inconsistent, the same ' for' is silent elsewhere, and the circuit is diffuse with weak members.

result.description: Fires on the 'itions' piece completing "transitions", mainly in "phase transitions" in physics/chemistry text. Members detect "trans" plus continuation pieces. It is silent on unrelated text.

result.description: Fires weakly on assorted function words (' of', ' and', ' by', ' the') and some nouns like ' resources' in formal expository text. Peaks are scattered and the circuit failed faithfulness, so the pattern is unclear.

result.description: Fires on varied modifier or noun tokens (social, identity, space, -ful, MS, System) that come mid-phrase in a compound noun phrase, where the next word is a head noun like media or API. Context is branding, design, writing and tech. Weak evidence; peaks are scattered.

result.description: Fires weakly on scattered tokens (the inside hyphenated compounds like over-the-road, "establishing", "showcasing", "conditions"), with no dominant token. Members are diffuse token detectors, and the circuit failed faithfulness, so the evidence is thin.

venue suffix piece 'ue/ues'
