result.description: Fires on connective tokens (' of', ' and', ' or', 'ing') and word pieces after an abstract noun phrase in academic or abstract prose, e.g. "expression and iterative". It is silent on many ' of' cases. The circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Connectives after abstract noun phrases

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (parentheses, additional, within, read, commonly) inside text explaining parentheses and punctuation usage. Members detect parentheses, punctuation and grammar terms. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Parentheses/punctuation explanation text

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments or short tokens inside multi-piece words and acronyms (R in Objective(RPO), 'ation', ')(' , ' rec', 'ac'), where the word is still being spelled out. The peak tokens are mixed and the circuit is weak and diffuse.
result.label: Mid-word fragments and acronym pieces

result.description: Attention latent firing on scattered tokens, often mid-word pieces or math symbols (∂x, Kep-f-ler, '2' in a formula, 'batt-les'), with a weak ' Roman' peak. Silent on ' Roman' in culture text. Evidence is mixed; no coherent trigger.
result.label: Scattered mid-word and math tokens

result.description: Fires on tokens following or continuing the word "pair/pairing" (the 'ing' of pairing, "of electrons", "and", "opposite" after pair), tracking the earlier "pair" word. Silent on 'ing' in other words like cooking or analyzing.
result.label: Tokens after 'pair' (pairing)

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and closing parentheses (')', ' of', ' to', 'Do') in academic or technical prose. Peaks are mixed with no dominant token, and members are generic. Evidence is thin and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Scattered function words in academic prose

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' as', ' like', ' of', ' such', ' ratio', ' c') in expository technical text, often where a noun is followed by an example or relation phrase. Peaks are inconsistent and it stays silent on some 'such as' cases. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed connectives in expository text

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings like 'board', 'bs' (in "Adverbs"), and 'ix' (in "infix"), often inside compound or linguistic-term words. Peaks are mixed word fragments, and the contrast evidence is thin.
result.label: Word fragments: board, bs, ix

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments in the middle of a longer word, mostly 'se' in "Morse" (also 'al' in Moral, ' incon', ' uns', 'dra', 'techn'). The contrast has lowercase "morser", where it stays silent.
result.label: Mid-word fragment, 'se' in Morse

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' impl' (implant) and sometimes ' surg' in medical or biomedical text, where a word is cut into pieces. Members include medical context detectors and word-start piece detectors.
result.label: ' impl' fragment in medical text

result.description: Fires on varied abstract plural or noun-like tokens (ences, trends, ers, conditions, time, environment) ending a noun phrase in descriptive expository text. No dominant token and the contrast gives no clear condition; the pattern is diffuse.
result.label: Noun-phrase-ending abstract nouns, diffuse

result.description: Fires on a mid-word or symbol token that completes or continues a technical term, often capital 'N' or 'G' in acronyms, and on math notation such as \mathfrak{g}, \subset or \rangle. Silent on some acronym N cases. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weakly faithful.
result.label: Acronym letters and math-notation pieces

result.description: Fires on varied word endings and nouns (satisfaction, Res-pect, -agement, -ale) in workplace/HR and management-style text, such as employee satisfaction and respect for values. Peaks are mixed, and the circuit is mostly employee/workforce topic members.
result.label: Workplace satisfaction/respect word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " pre"/" Pre" (e.g. prepositions, prevalence, prebiotic), strongest in "prepositions". It is a prefix detector for "pre" at the start of a word, which the next piece completes.
result.label: "pre" word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (setting, -ulation, -ulating, policy, events) in abstract expository lists about roles or influence, such as "influencing weather events" or "setting policy goals". It sits where a governance or management noun or verb is expected. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Policy/regulation verbs in role descriptions

result.description: Fires mostly on " hypothesis" after "null" or "alternative" in statistical hypothesis-testing text, and on "uri" in "Venturi". Silent on "hypothesis" as a plain noun in "hypothesis formulation/testing" lists.
result.label: null hypothesis / Venturi token

result.description: Fires on varied word-piece endings (-ity, -ocracy, -hip, -ics, 'ried') and on repeated "Education and X" title lines in a list of short headings. Peaks are scattered; the circuit is weak and mixed.
result.label: Scattered suffixes in Education headings

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens (' of', ' last', ' cook', ' West') that often are a word-start or fragment inside a larger word/phrase, especially 'out of', 'out-', 'last(ing)'. Silent on ordinary ' of' after nouns like 'consequences of'.
result.label: 'out of' / 'last' word-piece mix

result.description: Fires on the token " other", most strongly in the reciprocal phrase "each other" (also "on the other hand", "all other"). Weaker on "some other" and "another". Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: " other" in "each other"

result.description: Fires on the token ' true' when it is the truth value of a proposition in logic text (e.g. "both propositions are true", "P is true"). Weak on other senses like "true positives". Silent on truth-table text without the word.
result.label: ' true' in propositional logic

result.description: Fires on forms of "look" (looks, look, looking), also on "ose" in the name Bose. Members are detectors of look-forms and similar verbs like appears. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "look" verb forms and Bose

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rac' inside "terracotta"/"terraced" (and in intracellular/extracellular), but stays silent on 'rac' in "embraced". Also weakly fires on 'at' pieces in words like "aquatic".
result.label: 'rac' piece in terracotta/terraced

result.description: Fires on ' day' and ' time' as time-unit words, especially in compounds like real-time, daytime, every day, and weakly on 'timely'. It stays silent on 'modern day' used as an adjective.
result.label: day / time word in compounds

result.description: Fires on verbs meaning "ensure/guarantee" (ensure, guarantee, ens-uring, -ures) when a subject like a technique or property is said to secure an outcome, typically before a "that" clause or object. Silent on unrelated math text.
result.label: ensure / guarantee verbs

result.description: Fires mostly on the word-initial piece ' l' when it begins "lens/lenses" (also "lymph"), especially after "convex". Weaker on a few other word-start pieces like ' Der' and ' James'. It is silent on ' l' in "crossl-ensING".
result.label: ' l' starting "lens" words

result.description: Fires on the prefix ' un' as a separate word piece starting a negated word, mostly after a conjunction or in a list ("and un-", "or un-"). It stays quiet on ' un' in "unlocking" after "to".
result.label: ' un' prefix after conjunction
' herm' piece in hermeneutics
result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' herm' at the start of "hermeneutics" and related words, in philosophical academic text. Weaker on other word-initial fragments like 'stag' in stagflation.

Fires on the token ' rules' (occasionally 'conventions'), especially after a modifier like "grammar", "spelling" or "hyphenation" in language or rule-focused text. Members mostly detect 'rules' and similar words such as laws and regulations.
result.label: ' rules' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' Pos' (as in Logical Positivism) and ' Sem' (as in Semantic ...) when they begin a longer academic term split into tokens. Weaker on other mid-word pieces. Silent on the plain-text paraphrase.
result.label: Pos-/Sem- word-start pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " cross" as a prefix, as in "cross-cultural" or "cross-validation". It also fires weakly on commas in ascending number lists. Members are mostly detectors of " cross".
result.label: " cross" prefix (cross-cultural)

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces of biochemistry/nutrition terms, such as carbohydr-"ates" and Kre-"bs", in metabolism text. It stays silent on "ates" in ordinary verbs like investigates or mediates.
result.label: Biochemistry term endings (carbohydrates, Krebs)

result.description: Fires on the word "color"/"colors" and pieces like "hue" (h+ue), mostly in descriptive text about appearance, art or food. Silent when "color" appears in a bare list at the start of a text.
result.label: color word and hue pieces

result.description: Fires on ' are' (sometimes ' is') as the verb right after a relative pronoun or "that/who/what/you" in a relative clause ("items that are", "who are", "what you are saying"). Silent on ' are' after plain plural noun subjects.
result.label: 'are' in relative clauses

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: ' explanation' (and explan-ations), ' reven' in "revenues", and ' Vit'. Members detect explain/explanation tokens. Peaks are mixed across unrelated words, so the shared role is weak.
result.label: explanation / reven / Vit tokens

result.description: Fires on ' new' as an adjective after a verb or preposition that introduces novelty, like "bring new ideas" or "opening up new avenues". It stays silent on "each new era".
result.label: ' new' as object-introducing adjective

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' tor' at the start of words like torque, toroidal and torchbearer, where the next piece completes the word. Members include detectors of ' tor', 'que' and other word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' tor' word-start piece (torque)

result.description: Fires on word pieces in mercantilism/wealth economic-history text: 'il' in mercantil(ism), 'y' in wealthy, and ' and' after 'wealth'. It stays silent on 'il' in unrelated words like tranquil.
result.label: mercantil-ism / wealth(y) word pieces

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments inside multi-token words, mainly ' patch' (as in patches/patching), 'chni' in "Techniques", and 'mu' in Langmuir. It is silent on a plain ' patch' in the contrast. Logits favor suffix pieces like 'yst', 'es', 'ides'.
result.label: Word-fragment pieces: patch, Techni(ques)

result.description: Fires mainly on " traditional" (also purely, rural, manual) when it follows "from/away from the" in a contrast between old and new methods or paradigms, as in a shift from traditional linear models.
result.label: "traditional" in shift-from contrasts

result.description: Fires on the closing parenthesis right after an acronym in parentheses, such as (EIA), (NEA) or (AI), mostly in regulatory or technical text. It stays silent on the bare acronym without the parenthesis.
result.label: Closing paren after acronym

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces like 'ims' (aims), 'ors' (endeavors), 'iration', 'ions', ' resource' in formal or academic prose, often where a verb like "aims to" follows. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low; the evidence is thin.
result.label: Word-ending suffix pieces (aims, endeavors)

result.description: Fires diffusely on varied tokens, often the word or number piece right after "and the" or inside a list/abstract noun phrase (emot-, origin, effect-, digits in years). Peaks are scattered and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered tokens after "and the"

result.description: Fires mostly on "ding" in "nodding" (also "ing", " arms") in text about listening and nonverbal body-language cues like eye contact and gestures. Members detect nod, eye contact, gesture and listening words.
result.label: nodding in body-language listening

result.description: Fires on word pieces such as 'al' in "causal", 'in' in "indeterminism", and ' theoretical' in scientific or academic text. It is silent on 'al' in words like thermal, tidal and detrimental, so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: Suffix pieces in causal/determinism words

result.description: Fires mostly on relative-clause ' that' after a plural noun, where a verb like enable/allow/reflect follows, plus 'ân' in Brâncuși. It is silent on some ' that' cases, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: Relative 'that' before verb

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'acc' (as in vaccines) and on ' Tra' at the start of "Traffic" headings. It fires on these specific fragments mid-word, where the next piece completes the word.
result.label: 'acc' and 'Tra' word fragments

result.description: Fires on word-internal suffix pieces like 'ets' in alphabets, 'et' in multifaceted, 'ant', and 'ary' in the middle of multi-token words. It is silent on 'ets' in blankets. Members are detectors of these pieces.
result.label: Mid-word suffix pieces (ets, et, ant)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'zz' in mezzanine, 'im' in decimals or calorimeters, and 'el' in Mandelbrot, in the middle of a longer word. It pushes toward word continuations like 'on', 'ac' and 'am'.
result.label: Mid-word fragments (zz, im, el)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'ound' in "surroundings", 'ol' in "Decolonization"/"cholesterol", and 'll' in "syllables", where the word is still incomplete. Predicts word-completion pieces. Mixed, weaker hits on other words.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: ound, ol, ll

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ash' in "cash" (cash flow text), and also on mid-word pieces like 'bin' in "recombinant" and 'oups'. Mixed, scattered peaks; looks like a word-piece completion detector, mainly for "cash".
result.label: 'ash' in cash, plus word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on the piece 'ge' or 'gent' in 'converge'/'convergent' in math text about series and functions. Weaker hits on other word pieces like ' last'. It stays silent on 'ge' in 'emerge', so it needs the converge context.
result.label: 'conver-ge/gent' word piece

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word or byte-fragment tokens, often inside Arabic or other non-Latin script, broken multibyte characters and odd symbols. Members mostly detect Arabic letters and 'ال' pieces. Peaks are mixed and low-consistency.
result.label: Arabic and byte-fragment pieces

result.description: Fires on ' the' that opens a new clause subject, mainly after "that" or a leading comma in abstract science/math/logic text ("implies that the", "becomes, the higher"). Silent on ' the' after prepositions or verbs as object.
result.label: ' the' starting clause subject

result.description: Fires mostly on 'oven' completing "Beethoven" after a composer-name context, with weaker firing on digits in birth/death years and a few word endings. Members are music, art and name-piece detectors. Silent on lowercase 'eth|oven'.
result.label: Beethoven 'oven' piece in composer lists
'ild' in guild; 'accommod' stem
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ild' in "guild" and on ' accommod' in accommodate/accommodation, with rare hits on 'omer' and ' whose'. Mostly token-specific detectors of these pieces within those words.

Fires mostly on " magnetic" (also "magnet" pieces) in physics text, with a secondary peak on " ups" in "upswings" in economics. Members are mostly magnet/magnetic token detectors. Predicts continuations like "ax", "variable".
result.label: ' magnetic' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' Quant' when it starts a repeated "Quantum ..." heading in a list of subfield names, e.g. after "Quantum Computing.¶". Weakly on 'lingu' pieces. Silent on other list items such as biology fields.
result.label: ' Quant' starting Quantum list items

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer split words, mostly 'ong' (el-ong-ation, am-ong) and 'pos' (pre-pos-itions), also ' ther' and ' flu'. It needs the piece to be in the middle of a multi-token word, where a suffix follows.
result.label: Mid-word fragments 'ong' / 'pos'

result.description: Fires on word pieces like "ful" in playful, "ber" in blueberries, and "rich" or "our" (colour/flavour) in descriptive art, style and food text. Members are art, style, cooking and Renaissance detectors. The peak tokens are scattered.
result.label: Descriptive adjective suffixes in art/style text

result.description: Fires mainly on " recall" (memory recall, precision/recall metrics), also " toler" (tolerance) and "wear" after "resistance to". Members detect recall, memory, precision and related terms. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: recall (and tolerance/wear) token

result.description: Fires on ' with' introducing an elaborating clause after a comma ("..., with each member having..."). It stays silent when 'with' is a verb or preposition complement, as in "itself with" or "in contrast with".
result.label: Comma-introduced ' with' elaboration

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'pan' piece inside "discrepancies", with weaker firing on ' type' in "a type of" and some other scattered tokens. Members are mostly detectors of mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'pan' in discrepancies

result.description: Fires on "topology" and its variants ("ologies", "ology") in mathematical text about topology, metric spaces and algebraic structures. Weaker on nearby math words like "metric" and "dimensions". Silent in generic math text such as subgroups.
result.label: Topology word in math text

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining a noun pair, especially "goods and" before services/technologies in trade and economics text. Silent on clause-joining ' and' after commas or semicolons (and vice versa, and hence).
result.label: 'and' after goods (noun coordination)

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' w' (with a leading space) when it is a separate token, mostly in physics and economics text. It pushes towards continuations like 'avel', 'elf' and 'age'. It stays quiet when ' w' is at document start.
result.label: Word-initial ' w' fragment

result.description: Fires mostly on ' their' (also possessive 's, apostrophes, ' this') in abstract text about rights, laws, and groups, where a possessive determiner precedes a noun. It is silent on some ' their' cases like 'aligned their sponsorship'.
result.label: Possessive ' their' in abstract text

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: ' era' at the start of a document ("The era from..."), 'ides' in "strides", plural 's' after acronyms (EnPIs), and weakly hyphens. Silent on ' era' mid-sentence. Logits unclear.
result.label: era, strides, acronym plural s

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of longer, rarer words or names (mezz-ot-int, Arch-ib-ald, inter-war, Ma-o, sp-anning), where the word is not yet complete. Peak tokens are scattered and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments of rare words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' rein' (before "forcement") and on ' R' starting repeated "Risk ..." list items, plus a few other word-start fragments like 'aneous'. Seems to mark an incomplete word-start piece or repeated list item.
result.label: ' rein' and ' R' word-start pieces
'es' in Trees, ' convey' in conveyance
result.description: Fires on the 'es' piece of "Trees" (mostly in binary/graph-theory tree headings) and on ' convey', especially in "conveyance". It stays silent on 'es' in other words like "necesses", "loves" or "sandwiches".
Fires on the word piece ' Dat' when it starts "Datum/Datums" (e.g. "Horizontal Datum", "Datum A and Datum B"). Weak activation on a few other tokens like 'ions' and 'individuals'.
result.label: ' Dat' in Datum

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly in garbled Cyrillic-like pseudo-text (о, ство, ков, ре) and some word pieces like 'au', 'in', 'mark'. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low; the circuit is poorly faithful and unclear.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in garbled text
Mid-word fragments 'it' and 'plan'
result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of longer words, mainly 'it' (hosp-it-als, Ant-it-rust) and 'plan' in 'interplanetary', plus ' Hash' in 'Hashing'. It needs a preceding word-start fragment.

Fires on the word ' where' when it introduces a relative clause after a noun or phrase (e.g. "fields where", "from finance where"). Members are mostly detectors of ' where' and similar wh-words like ' when'. The contrast text has no ' where'.
result.label: relative clause ' where'

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ize, -izing, -ities) completing the word "prioritize/priorities", with members detecting "prior-"/"it" and "priority" context. Silent on "ize" in other words like "minimize" or "optimize".
result.label: Suffix of prioritize/priorities

result.description: Fires on surname or name pieces (Johnson, Anderson, 'am') in lists of academic names like "Dr. Smith.¶ Dr. Johnson.", and on the period ending such entries. Members detect "Dr", "Professor David" and similar name pieces. Stays silent on periods after headings.
result.label: Names in Dr./Professor name lists

result.description: Fires on " or" joining two adjectives or materials that are alternative options, like "synthetic or natural" or "cast iron or stainless", mostly in product, cooking or materials text. It is silent on "or" between food items or verbs.
result.label: " or" between alternative materials/adjectives

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens: a '1' inside long binary or decimal digit strings, and word-piece endings like 'al' in 'viral', 'itudes' in 'attitudes', 'oses'. It stays silent on '1' in years. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Mixed digit '1' and word-piece endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ent' in 'Pres-ent' (Present Simple/Continuous/Perfect grammar headings), and weakly on 'Endanger-ed'. Silent on 'ent' ending other words like imminent, prevalent, coherent.
result.label: 'ent' in Present (tense) split word

result.description: Fires on economic-policy words (' tax', ' policy', 'intervention', ' government') in macroeconomics and Keynesian fiscal-policy text. It is silent on one ' tax' in a supply-side passage. Members are tax detectors and economy-topic latents.
result.label: Fiscal policy words in economics text

result.description: Fires on ' word' (esp. "spoken word") and ' po' in "memory pools" (word-start piece before "ols"), plus a few 'words' and digits. Silent on 'word' in "a single word" or "worded". Mixed tokens, seemingly context-specific.
result.label: spoken 'word' and memory 'po'ols

result.description: Fires on varied function words and noun pieces (of, in, on, enses, simple) inside text about linguistics and grammar, especially verb tenses. Members are mostly language and grammar topic detectors. Silent on 'of' in other topics.
result.label: Linguistics/grammar text, tense passages

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces and nouns (rice, pasta's 'a', cheese 'ese', reactors, 'ol', 'uring') that often end a first part of a compound or noun phrase, with food/cooking and technical terms. Peaks are scattered and the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Scattered word pieces, food and technical

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis after a capitalized technical term or title, where an acronym is about to be given, e.g. "Virtual Reality (VR)", "Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)". Quiet on some similar cases such as "Internet of Things (IoT".
result.label: Paren introducing acronym after term

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: 'ars' in "seminars/webinars", ' ray' (cosmic ray, incident ray), and ' glo' in "globe". Silent on 'ars' in "bears" or "pulsars", so it needs the right word.
result.label: 'ars' in seminars/webinars, ray

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin "conduct" (conductivity, conduction) and "aller" (allergy, allergen), plus ' through' in a conduction context. It predicts continuations like "duct". Weaker on a few mid-word fragments.
result.label: conduct- / aller- word onsets

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ic' in "intricacy/intricately", 'inos' in "luminosity", and ' pian' in "pianos". It stays quiet on 'ic' in words like "hypnotic", "symbolic" and "magic". Members mostly detect 'ic' pieces.
result.label: Word-piece 'ic' in intricate/pianos

result.description: Fires on the word piece " turn" (also " thrust") when it is the first part of a compound like turnover or thrusters, and predicts a continuation such as "over" or "around". Members are mostly detectors of "turn" and its variants.
result.label: turn- / thrust- word start
Mid-word pieces after "provided a/the"
result.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split, fairly abstract word (catal-yz-ed, a p-ivotal, blue-print, sc-affolding, inst-illing) in formal expository text about policy or history, often after "a/the" or "provided". Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.

Fires on the mid-word piece 'ureau' in 'bureaucracy/bureaucratic' (after 'b'), with a few other word-internal pieces like 'perm' in 'sperm'. Members detect word-piece fragments such as 'atic', 'hier', 'ag'.
result.label: 'ureau' in bureaucracy

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'elf' in "Welfare", 'ights' in "knights", and 'amp'/'ight', where the piece sits inside a longer word split into tokens. Silent on 'elf' in "oneself", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: Word-internal fragments: elf in Welfare

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " concurrent" (as an adjective before systems, operations, garbage collection), with minor peaks on "iev" and "partial". Members detect concurrency/parallel computing words, such as "concurrency", "parallel" and "deadlock".
result.label: ' concurrent' in computing text

result.description: Fires on ' outside' mostly, plus ' join' (as in SQL left/right join) and enter/entering. These are boundary or crossing words. Members detect outside, inside, external and within. Logits are unclear.
result.label: outside / join / enter words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ure" inside "procurement" (also "Sculpture"), when mid-sentence after "proc". It stays silent on the same piece in some contexts, such as sentence-initial "Procurement" or a parenthesized list item.
result.label: "ure" in procurement

result.description: Fires mostly on " layers" (and nearby words like "of"/"within" after layer talk) in text about layering, e.g. art techniques, dough, neural networks. Predicts "layer(s)" next. Members are layer-token detectors.
result.label: layers token detector

result.description: Fires on the token " charge" (electric charge in physics text, e.g. "two types of charge", "point charge"). Members are mostly detectors of " charge" and " charges". Silent on other atomic-physics text without that word.
result.label: electric charge token

result.description: Fires mostly on " genius" (including "geniuses"/"genioused" forms), and also on scattered pieces like "GO" in LEGO, "phony", "ematic". Peaks are mixed and the members are mostly generic token detectors.
result.label: ' genius' token plus scattered pieces

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' in numerals, such as years (1910, 1859), version numbers (1.10.1) and list numbers. It boosts following digits like 9, 8 and 6. It stays silent on '3' in list items.
result.label: Digit '1' starting numbers

result.description: Fires on the later tokens of a short title or topic heading at the start of a document, such as "The Little Ice Age" or "The Scientific Revolution". It fires on the heading's last word or word piece. Evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Title-phrase tokens in headings

result.description: Fires on adjective/noun suffix pieces like 'ial', 'ical', 'ist', 'ural' that begin a word right after a sentence-ending period, apparently a word fragment starting a new sentence. Silent on ordinary sentence starts.
result.label: Suffix fragments after sentence end

result.description: Fires on mixed connecting words (' as', ' through', ' when', ' for', ' that') and word pieces like 'elling'/'ently', mostly in science or explanatory text, where they link a preceding noun phrase to a following clause. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are diffuse.
result.label: Mixed connectives in explanatory text

result.description: Fires on varied abstract nouns and function words in academic or abstract expository prose (e.g. "needs", "unity", "the", "various"), often after lists or "and". No dominant token. Silent on "and" inside plain lists of nouns.
result.label: Scattered tokens in abstract academic prose

result.description: Fires on the token ' P' (capital P with leading space), mostly as the probability symbol P(A|B) in math text, but also as a word-initial piece in names or phrases like "Noun P-hrase". Members are mostly ' P' token detectors.
result.label: Capital ' P' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'et' (multifacet-ed, -etric, -etylene), 'anger' in endangered, and 'pler' in Kepler. Mostly sub-word pieces inside longer words; silent on 'et' in tapestry. Members are 'et' detectors.
result.label: Mid-word 'et'/'anger' fragments
Word-start piece of lux-/prosper- words
result.description: Fires on incomplete word-start pieces like ' lux' (luxury, luxurious) and ' prosper' (prosperity), also ' east', ' kilom', where a suffix completes the word. Predicts word-ending pieces such as 'ury' and 'ity'.

Fires on varied function and generic words (changes, is, and, this) inside text about geological eras like the Paleozoic, Cambrian and Permian. Members detect earth-science and deep-time word pieces. Peak tokens are scattered, so evidence is mixed.

result.label: ' du' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on a hyphen inside a multi-part hyphenated compound, strongest in "out-of-order", "best-case", and chained hyphens, where more hyphenated pieces follow. Weaker for "well-defined". Silent on hyphens after "Second", "Third", "data", "high".
result.label: Hyphen in compound words

result.description: Fires mostly on the word " my" (also " myself") when it is mentioned or listed as a word, plus long runs of dashes and some markdown markers. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is only partly faithful.
result.label: ' my' / ' myself' word mentions, dash runs

result.description: Fires on the adjective " modern" (also " Modern", " contemporary"), mostly before a noun such as computing, systems or processors. Members are detectors of modern/contemporary/era words. The contrast text has no such word.
result.label: modern / contemporary adjective

result.description: Fires on linear-algebra vocabulary such as "basis", "independence", "dimensionality" and "vector", mostly in "a basis" or "linear independence" contexts. It stays silent on "basis" after "each" or "fundamental". Weak, mixed evidence.
result.label: Linear algebra terms (basis, independence)

result.description: Fires on the space token right after "ISO" (before standard numbers like ISO 14001), and sometimes on " Trans" in a title. It stays silent on spaces before years or other numbers, so it needs the ISO standard context.
result.label: Space after ISO before number

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece ' med' when it begins "meditation"/"meditative" in yoga and spiritual-practice text. It also fires weakly on ' Indian' and ' conclus'. Members are mostly detectors of word-initial fragments.
result.label: ' med' in meditation

result.description: Fires on the digit '0' directly after a leading "2" in 21st-century years (2000, 2003, 2010, 2000s). It stays silent on '0' after 19x/198/195 (decade digits like 1990s).
result.label: Zero in 2000s years

result.description: Fires on the newline/paragraph-break token (shown as ¶) that ends a short list item or heading line, such as "Language Promotion." in a list of topics. Silent on a break at the very start of a document.
result.label: Newline after short list item

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emer' that begins "emergency", "emergence" or "emerging", mostly mid-sentence before "-gency". Members are mainly ' emer' detectors from early layers. The contrast text has no ' emer' token.
result.label: ' emer' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on process nouns or noun-ending pieces (growth, differentiation, fertilization, replication, division, detection) in biology text about cell development and reproduction. Peaks are scattered and consistency is low.
result.label: Biological process noun endings

result.description: Fires mainly on ' gates' (51 of 64 peaks), especially in "quantum gates" or "logic gates". It also fires weakly on a few unrelated word endings. Members include detectors for gate and quantum bits.
result.label: ' gates' in quantum/logic gates

result.description: Fires on Cyrillic word pieces like 'мо', 'ла', 'ско' and ' свои' inside garbled, scrambled Russian-like text. Weak elsewhere. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic character detectors, so it looks like a noisy-text fragment feature.
result.label: Cyrillic fragments in garbled text

result.description: Fires on scattered function words and word pieces (' in', ' of', ' sub', 'ing', ' left') in academic or technical prose, often after a noun like "change in" or "consolidation of". Silent on many ' in' tokens, so the pattern is mixed.
result.label: Scattered ' in'/' of' in academic prose

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'bo' in "hyperbole" (also "carbohydrate"), plus 'mos' and ' Napoleon'. It is a within-word piece detector for a few multi-token words; the evidence is mixed and the weaker contexts are unrelated.
result.label: 'bo' in hyperbole/carbohydrate

result.description: Fires on ' of' after an abstract head noun (legend, case, problem, idea, aspect) in academic or math text. It stays silent on ' of' after words like hints, instead, phase and seekers.
result.label: ' of' after abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on topical modifier or noun words like "environmental", "economic", "energy", and the "ain" in "sustainable", in science, energy and policy text. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low, so the exact trigger is unclear.
result.label: Energy/environment/economic topic words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' real' at the start of a longer word or compound (realm, realistic, realism, real-world, real-time). It predicts word continuations. It is silent on unrelated contrast text.
result.label: ' real' as word-start piece

result.description: Fires on "wider" and "broader" (including the split piece "ader" after "bro"), and weakly on "broad(ens)". It marks comparative adjectives of breadth or extent that come before a noun like scope, range or distribution.
result.label: wider / broader comparatives

result.description: Fires mostly on ' acid' (and 'ids') in chemistry text about acids, e.g. carboxylic, citric, acid dissociation. Also weakly on pieces like 'pect' in Respect and 'adj' in adjacency. Silent on 'acid rain' in a casual context.
result.label: Acid in chemistry contexts
Memory as heading in computing topics
result.description: Fires mostly on " Memory" as a title or heading word in computer-architecture outlines (Cache Memory, Virtual Memory, Memory Management). Weaker on " mini" and "ic". Members are mostly detectors of "memory"/"Memory" tokens.

Fires mostly on ' of' (also ' to', ' in') right after abstract nouns of difficulty or challenge, like "complexity of", "difficulty of", "danger of". It stays silent on ' of' after nouns like "form", "member", "interplay".
result.label: ' of' after difficulty/challenge nouns

result.description: Fires on the verb " help" (also helps/helping) when it takes a subject like a technology or method and is followed by an object and a verb, as in "X can help cities reduce...". Members are mostly help/assist/enable detectors.
result.label: verb "help" before an object

result.description: Fires on the document-start/separator token (shown as ¶) when it comes after a finished short entry in a list of items, such as names or topics, with a new entry about to start. Silent when it is the very first token of the text.
result.label: Separator token between list entries

result.description: Fires on ' remote' (as in remote sensing) and on ' Aug' at the start of "Augmented Reality", a word-initial piece of a technical term. Weaker on other word fragments like "etic" and "ide". Members detect ' remote' and sensing-related tokens.
result.label: ' remote' and ' Aug' in tech terms

result.description: Fires on the word " creating" (also "creates"/"create"), mostly as a participle after a comma or "and" that introduces an effect or result, as in "creating tension". Members include detectors of create-type words.
result.label: ' creating' participle token

result.description: Fires on the token ' creation', typically as a noun in phrases like "content creation" or "the creation of". Members are mostly ' creation' detectors plus similar -tion nouns such as generation and separation.
result.label: ' creation' token detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, most often 'ous' in "nervous (system)", also ' Vo', 'F', ' recip'. It is silent on 'ous' in "ubiquitous" and sometimes in "Central Nervous", so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: Word-piece 'ous' in nervous

result.description: Fires on hyphens inside letter-by-letter spellings and mid-word fragments (s-f-l-o-w, 'ron' in micron, 'orous' in humorous). Silent on hyphens in ordinary compounds like high-performance or left-handed.
result.label: Hyphen in spelled-out words

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'ho' in "Khoisan"/"Khoikhoi" and 'ased' in "unbiased". It depends on being inside those specific words, after a K- or unbi- prefix. Members detect 'ho' and name-fragment tokens.
result.label: 'ho' in Khoisan, 'ased' in unbiased

result.description: Fires on the word " sample" used as a modifier in statistics text (sample mean, sample data, sample size, sample to sample). Silent when " sample" starts a text fragment with no preceding context.
result.label: statistical " sample" modifier
'ent' in 'inherent'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ent' completing 'inher-ent' (also 'trinsic'-type pieces like 'insic'), mostly in abstract academic text. Silent on unrelated text. Members are mostly 'ent' token detectors.
Fires on the token " brand" in marketing text, as in brand performance, brand equity or brand loyalty. It is silent when "brand" starts a text with no marketing context before it.
result.label: ' brand' in marketing text

result.description: Fires on the second word piece after a capital "A" at the start of a word or acronym (A|IC, A|est-hetic, A|do-pting, A|lib-aba), i.e. mid-word fragments following an initial "A". Predicts word continuations.
result.label: Word piece following initial "A"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'loy' inside 'unemployed' / 'employee' (after 'emp'), and more weakly on 'ment' in 'employment'. Needs the employment-word context; 'loy' in 'alloy' is not supported by the members.
result.label: 'loy' in unemployed/employee
Final 'I' of acronym AI
result.description: Fires on the final letter 'I' of the acronym "AI" (also 'L' in RL, 'T' in RT) when it ends a capitalised acronym, mostly in AI-related technical text. Silent on the spelled-out phrase "machine learning".

Fires on " also" (rarely "accordingly", "thus") as an adverb placed before a main verb, as in "have also evolved" or "can also dampen". It stays quiet after "but also", "while also", or at the start of a sentence.
result.label: ' also' before a verb

result.description: Fires on passive-participle verbs like "represented" or "expressed" after "can be/is", mostly in mathematical text (matrices, vectors, equations), where something is described as being represented by or as something else.
result.label: "can be represented/expressed" in math
Mid-word pieces: tapest, hydroxide, heterogeneous
result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of specific multi-piece words, mainly 'apest' (tapestry), 'ogeneous' (heterogeneous/homogeneous) and 'x' in hydroxide, with a few weak function-word hits. Evidence is mixed and the contrast is not informative.

Fires on scattered tokens: word pieces like 'ulate', 'arding', ' cot', 'ction', and digit '1' inside year-like numbers. No dominant token or topic; the target is silent on '1' in other number contexts. Evidence is mixed and the circuit is weak.
result.label: Scattered word pieces and year digits

result.description: Fires on the word ' respect' in both senses: "with respect to" in maths and respect as a value (mutual respect, respectful). It is silent when 'respect' starts the text as a fragment ("respectful setting").
result.label: ' respect' token detector

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated word pieces: "om" in "chromosomes", "pon" in "Exponential", and the word " security". Mixed peaks with weak consistency; the circuit is made of token detectors for each of these pieces.
result.label: security / pon / om word pieces

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens inside dates, numbers, and ordinals (digits, 'th' after century numbers, dashes in year ranges), but is silent on some ordinals like '19th'. Evidence is mixed and the peaks are diffuse.
result.label: Digits and dashes in dates

result.description: Fires on the word " visual" (as in "visual arts", "visual aids", "visual language"), usually as an adjective after "the" or another modifier. Members are mostly detectors of "visual" and related word pieces.
result.label: " visual" token detector

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after a verb like "setting", "getting", or "reflect", especially in "setting the tone/pace". Stays quiet on ' the' after prepositions such as "of", "in", or "throughout".
result.label: ' the' after setting/verb

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word that is split mid-word (' Pol' before "lution", ' far', ' Supp', ' Fin', 'respons' in "irresponsibility"), often in list-like headings. It expects a word continuation. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word-initial fragment before continuation
'ado' piece in 'paradox'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ado' inside 'paradox' (par-ado-x). Weaker on mid-word pieces like 'nt' in 'sovereignty' and 'agog' in 'pedagogical'. Silent when 'ado' starts a text without 'par' before it.

result.label: 'ers' ending of "researchers"
result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix 'ers' completing "researchers" (also weaker on astronomers, geologists), typically as the subject or object of a verb like "allow researchers to". Silent on 'ers' in other words such as engineers.

Fires on word-final pieces like 'ance' in "disturbance" and 'charge' in "recharge", in ecology/hydrology text. It stays silent on 'ance' in reliance, enhance, accordance, acceptance, so it needs the disturbance-type word.
result.label: disturbance/recharge word endings

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of longer words (gress in aggressive, descript, init in indefinites, irect, inn) where the word is likely to continue with an adjective-like suffix such as -ive. Predicts 'ive', 'ively', 'ory'.
result.label: Word fragment before -ive suffix

result.description: Fires on a hyphen joining parts of a compound or sequence, such as light-dependent, vowel-consonant-vowel, or 1-2-3. Silent on some hyphens after prefixes or in -like/-ful. Members are hyphen detectors boosting 'based', 'related', 'level'.
result.label: Hyphen inside compounds and sequences

result.description: Fires mainly on ' corner' (esp. 'cornerstone') and on other word-start pieces like ' ve', ' tre', ' fasc', ' sem' that begin a longer word. Predicts a word-completion suffix such as 'iling' or 'raction'.
result.label: 'corner' and word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on digit tokens (0, 8, 5, 9) inside long digit strings or numerals, e.g. repeated zeros or nines in long numbers. Silent on '0' in years like 2022. Weak, mixed circuit with some unrelated members.
result.label: Digits inside long numbers

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces such as 'ining', 'ering', 'al' and 'id', and on stray digits or letters inside a word or number. The peaks are scattered, with no shared meaning. It is silent on 'ining' in ordinary words such as 'dining' and 'examining'.
result.label: Scattered mid-word suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces in photosynthesis/cell-biology text, such as "memb" in thylakoid membranes, "water" in water splitting, "phot" and "otos". Fires only within that biology topic, with weak activation elsewhere.
result.label: Photosynthesis biology word pieces

result.description: Fires on the adjectival suffix piece 'ical' (also 'astic', 'itative', 'ive') ending an academic or methodological adjective like empirical, neoclassical, autoregressive. It stays quiet on 'ical' in Mechanical and Physical at the start of a document.
result.label: Academic adjective suffix -ical

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece 'ro' in "Electro-" (electrochemical, electrolysis, electrode), and more weakly on technical math words like eigenvalues, threshold, principal. Predicts word continuations such as 'mon', 'lat'.
result.label: Electro- 'ro' piece, technical terms
Word-piece endings like -itting, -oning
result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces such as 'itting' (kn-itting), 'oning' (z-oning), 'ence', 'ent', completing a split word. Peaks are mixed; members mostly detect 'itting' and -ing endings.

Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word or name (' Rap' in Raphael/Rapid, 'uf' in Duflo, 'ffen') and on logical 'NOT'. Peaks are scattered, with low consistency, and the evidence doesn't show a single condition.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: Rap, uf, NOT

result.description: Fires on the copula ' is' or ' are' right after a noun-phrase subject (e.g. "the trench is", "the instruments are"), predicting a predicate. Silent when 'is' follows abstract "focus/objective/concept" subjects or starts a clause.
result.label: Copula is/are after noun subject

result.description: Fires on name pieces (first or last name fragments like -oster, -ica, -ia, -othy) in a list of "Dr. Name." entries, after "Dr." or "Professor". Also weakly on scattered other tokens. Mostly a name-list pattern; evidence is mixed.
result.label: Name fragments in Dr. lists
'en' in Krashen's name
result.description: Fires on the 'en' piece completing the surname "Krashen" (Stephen Krashen, Input Hypothesis), and weakly on other word-ending pieces like 'ic' or 'ely'. Members detect 'Kr'/'ash' and 'en' pieces.

Fires on mid-word technical word pieces like 'om' in monomers/diastereomers, 'apy' in therapy, and 'box' in black-box, mostly in scientific or medical text. It stays silent on 'om' at the start of a new word, as in 'omedicine'.
result.label: Technical word-piece fragments (om, apy, box)

result.description: Fires on word-piece suffixes (-ing, -al, -y, -ir) in the middle of a word, e.g. clank|ing, abyss|al, dust|y, in descriptive, literary prose after "amid/amidst". Silent on ordinary -ing verb forms.
result.label: Suffix pieces after rare stems

result.description: Fires on capitalized words or word pieces in Title Case headings and topic lists (Design, Band, Product, System, Integr), often at the start of a multi-word term. Peaks vary, and the target is silent on plain lists of names.
result.label: Title-case heading words

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments after a prefix, mainly 'orrow' in "tom|orrow", also 'ien' in "aud|ien|ces" and 'itor' in "aud|itor". It needs the specific preceding piece ('tom', 'aud'), so it is a word-completion detector.
result.label: Word-piece completion: tom-orrow, aud-ience

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ud' inside "fe-ud-al" (feudal/feudalism) when it follows a preceding "fe" piece mid-word. It stays silent when 'ud' starts the text or word without "fe" before it.
result.label: 'ud' in feudal

result.description: Fires mostly on hyphens joining a name or term to a following part (deuterium-helium-3, Edmonds-Karp, Carbon-Carbon), and sometimes on commas in lists of technical terms (soil orders). Silent on hyphens in common compounds like solid-state or decision-making.
result.label: Hyphen in technical name compounds

result.description: Fires on the digit token '2' inside multi-digit numbers, such as codes, years, ranges and dates, in non-initial positions. It predicts another digit next, mostly '0'. It stays silent on non-digit text.
result.label: Digit '2' within numbers

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "bra-" into "brackets"/"braces" (cket, ces), mostly in text about bracket punctuation. Weak activation elsewhere on scattered word pieces. Members are mostly detectors of the "bra" prefix and generic subword pieces.
result.label: Suffix after 'bra' (bracket/braces)

result.description: Fires on word-final suffix pieces like 'ence' in "audience", 'ines' in "Machines", 'Hz' in "kHz", and 'band'/'mark'. It stays silent on 'ence' in words like coherence, adherence, essence, so it needs specific host words.
result.label: Suffix pieces in audience, kHz, Machines

result.description: Fires on the first word of a document or sentence, mostly " This" (also " It", " Ens", " Crit"), at the start of a new text or section. Silent mid-sentence. Logits weakly favor section/article-type nouns.
result.label: Sentence-initial " This" at text start

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word pieces, often in non-English text (Arabic, Cyrillic, Japanese byte fragments) and word fragments like 'MT', 'ов', 'л', 'emble'. No clear shared token or meaning; the peaks look like word-internal fragments.
result.label: Scattered mid-word fragments, multilingual

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on assorted function words (' or', ',', ' they', ' to', ' by') and word pieces in expository text. Silent on many of its own ' or' tokens in lists, so the condition is unclear. Circuit faithfulness is poor.
result.label: Scattered function-word latent, unclear

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of technical terms and acronyms, such as ' SW' in SWOT, 'cos' in cosine and ecosystems, and 'CP', 'PP' and 'mes'. It seems to predict a continuation of the word. Evidence is mixed across fragments.
result.label: Technical word-start fragments (SW, cos)

result.description: Fires mainly on " Act" in names of laws (Clayton Antitrust Act, Stamp Act, Sherman Act), and more weakly on "colon" in colony/colonial words. Members detect "Act" and legislation words.
result.label: " Act" in statute names

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' ver' in "linking verbs" (before "bs"), also ' adj' and ' N' (Nouns) in grammar-lesson text about parts of speech. Weaker on other word-start fragments such as 'post-ver'.
result.label: Grammar term fragments (ver-bs, adj, N-ouns)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece ' Tre' (as in "Trees") in capitalized list or heading text, such as data-structure topic lists. It also fires weakly on other first pieces of split words like ' Bor' (Borel) and ' phr' (phrases).
result.label: ' Tre' piece in "Trees" headings

result.description: Fires on function words and word pieces (the, in, those, object, multiple) in text about third-person limited narrative point of view and character perspective. Silent on 'the' in other writing-craft contexts. Members detect narrative, character and "person" tokens.
result.label: Third-person narrative POV discussion

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments like 'ero' (superhero), ' Str' at the start of "Strategic" headings, and 'egu' in "safeguard". Mixed pieces, mostly early parts of multi-token words, with no shared meaning.
result.label: Word-start fragments: ero, Str, egu

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside longer words, most often 'ety' in "velvety", plus scattered pieces like 'h' in "seventh", 'FA', and 'ility'. Members mainly detect word-start pieces such as 'v' and 'vet'.
result.label: Word-piece 'ety' in velvety

result.description: Fires on 'hole', 'bore', 'shall' (of shallow) in borehole drilling and geotechnical text, e.g. "shallow bore holes", "borehole logging". Members detect drilling, material, earth and site-investigation words.
result.label: Borehole / shallow bore hole drilling

result.description: Fires on manner adverbs and adverb endings (perfectly, fully, precisely, -ously, -ibly, truly) that precede a participle or adjective. Upstream members detect -fully/-ically/-ally suffixes. Output favors past participles like executed, understood.
result.label: Degree/manner adverbs before participles

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' hel' at the start of words like helium, helicase, helix, predicting suffix pieces such as 'ic', 'ix', 'ium'. Weak activation on ' branch'. Silent on other science text without this piece.
result.label: ' hel' word-start piece (helium/helix)

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' eth' (also ' Eth') that begins words like ethical, ethics, ethnic and ethos. It is silent when 'eth' is the very first token of the document, and predicts word continuations such as 'ical' or 'ics'.
result.label: ' eth' word-start piece (ethics)

result.description: Fires on 'face' in "face-to-face" and on document-start or newline tokens in list-like headings of topic words (e.g. "Culinary Arts."). It stays silent on 'face' inside "Surface". Mixed evidence, with weak consistency.
result.label: face-to-face and list-start tokens

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' Chi' (as in Chi-Square) and 'uel' (in fuel/biofuel), plus a few others like 'HP'. It predicts continuation of a compound or word. Mixed tokens, weak consistency.
result.label: Chi / uel word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces in garbled or non-English text (Cyrillic like 'ран', 'на', Arabic letters), mostly inside longer words. Members are early-layer Arabic and Cyrillic piece detectors. Predicts name or suffix-like continuations.
result.label: Mid-word pieces in Cyrillic/Arabic text

result.description: Fires on a noun or gerund-like word in a comma-separated list of abstract nouns (validation, modeling, posting, passion, emotions), right after a comma. Peaks vary, with no single dominant token. Logits are weak.
result.label: Items in comma-separated noun lists

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece 'ist' in the middle of words, especially 'Cons-ist-ency', also Antagonist/Stalinist, and on ' First'. It marks a mid-word fragment where more letters follow.
result.label: Mid-word 'ist' fragment (Consistency)

result.description: Fires weakly and inconsistently on prepositions and connectives (into, to, with, through, while, by) and occasionally on digits, mid-sentence in technical or science text. The same ' to' stays silent elsewhere, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Scattered prepositions in technical text

result.description: Fires mainly on "idence" in "Confidence" (Confidence Intervals) near the start of statistics documents, and weakly on other tokens like " for" or " of" in the same context. Peak tokens are mixed, and the target stays silent on " for" elsewhere.
result.label: Confidence intervals title token

result.description: Weak, scattered attention circuit firing on mid-word fragments of names and rare words (Cla, Sim-éon, umam-aki, Maj-da), often in lists of mathematician names near "Legendre". Members are mostly generic token detectors; evidence is thin.
result.label: Name fragments in mathematician lists

result.description: Fires on the abbreviation pieces 'VAR' (vector autoregression), and 'IMA'/'MA' in ARIMA, in lists of statistical or time-series forecasting methods. Silent on the plain word "regression" in general economics text.
result.label: Time-series model acronyms (VAR, ARIMA)

result.description: Fires on ' criteria' and the following words in "criteria include/for ..." phrases (include, for, -ity, -ining). It is inconsistent: it stays silent on some ' criteria' tokens, and the evidence doesn't show what separates them.
result.label: criteria and follow-on words

result.description: Fires on scattered mid-word pieces and digits (e.g. '8' inside a number, 'orithms' in Algorithms, ' Li' in Liquid) where a word or number is unfinished. Members are token-level detectors of varied early-layer tokens; the evidence is mixed and weak.
result.label: Mid-word fragments and digits, mixed

result.description: Weak, mixed attention-layer target peaking on sentence-ending periods and scattered tokens (measurement, anging, 1) in a pH-indicator passage. Members mostly detect periods; the contrast shows periods elsewhere stay silent, and the condition is unclear.
result.label: Periods in pH-indicator text

result.description: Fires on " that" right after "ensure/ensuring/guarantees", the complementizer introducing the guaranteed outcome. It stays silent on " that" after implies, clarifies, belief or shown.
result.label: "that" after ensure/guarantee

result.description: Fires on the middle or later word piece of a person's surname split into pieces (Kil|by, No|yce, Fair|child), after a first name or company-linked name. Mostly semiconductor/tech pioneer names. Peak tokens vary.
result.label: Split surname pieces of named people

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (in, pass, these, online, real) shortly after "engage/engaging/engagement" words in text about engagement. Members detect "eng-"/"engagement" pieces. Silent on " in" when it doesn't follow an engage-type word.
result.label: Tokens following engage/engagement words

result.description: Fires on tokens shortly after the word "legacy" (e.g. "legacy of", "legacy of apart", "legacy is"), carrying that earlier word forward. It stays silent on "of" in other contexts. Members are mostly "legacy" detectors.
result.label: Tokens following "legacy"
Est-imation word piece after "Est"
result.description: Fires on the word pieces 'im'/'imation'/'ators' that complete "Estimation/Estimates/Estimators", especially in statistics headings. It stays silent on 'imation' in "Animation", so it needs the preceding "Est" piece.

Fires on tokens following or inside text about "mechanisms" (e.g. "mechanisms underpinning", "mechanisms that"), including function words after the word. Members detect "mechan-isms/mechanism/Mechanics". Peaks are scattered across tokens in mechanism-heavy passages.
result.label: Tokens in "mechanisms" passages

result.description: Fires mostly on the document-start token and on early LaTeX/code-start tokens (documentclass, ```latex, \[ , \frac). Silent on document-start tokens that follow a list of names. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Document start and LaTeX openers

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word "framework" (e.g. " for", " such", " known", " from", ","), where the framework noun is the previous word. It is silent on some " for" cases after "framework", so the condition is only partly clear. Members detect "framework" and law/legislation words.
result.label: Token following "framework"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' of', word pieces, ' it') in passages that contain the word "essence" earlier in the context. The members are mostly detectors of "ess"/"ence" tokens, so it looks like a context signal for essence-themed text. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Tokens in text about "essence"

result.description: Fires on demonstratives ' this'/' these' (and occasionally a possessive apostrophe) in argumentative, philosophical text, often after "argue"/"credit". It is silent on some identical ' this' tokens, and the evidence doesn't show why. The circuit fails and is weak.
result.label: Demonstrative this/these in argumentative text

result.description: Fires on the word " introduction", mostly when it is repeated or recurs after an earlier "introduction" in the text (e.g. "introduction or introduction of"). It stays silent on some uses, such as "the introduction into assembly line", so it appears to need that repetition.
result.label: Repeated 'introduction' token

result.description: Fires on 'erving' in "preserving" and on words right after "preserve" (' the', ' our', 'itage' in heritage), in text about preserving languages or heritage. Silent on some "preserving" instances, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: preserve/preserving heritage context

result.description: Fires on century expressions (" century", "Century", "-teenth" in "eighteenth") and punctuation right after "18th century", in historical text about eras. Weaker on other word pieces. Mostly a historical-period context.
result.label: Century expressions in historical text

result.description: Fires on ' theories' (and following 'and'/'or'/'that') in lists of academic theories and models, especially when a repeated "theories" is in an enumeration of foundational/subsequent theories. Silent after field-specific compound modifiers like "communication theories".
result.label: Repeated 'theories' in academic theory lists

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens (mid-word pieces, ' and', commas, periods) in dense linguistics/semantics text; it suppresses language-word predictions such as ' words' and ' language'. Peaks are inconsistent and the contrast is silent on ' and' in similar text.
result.label: Scattered tokens in linguistics text

result.description: Fires on " Deep" (also "deep") when it follows earlier repetitions of Deep/deep in the same text, as in repeated "Deep Deep" strings. It is silent on the first, document-initial "Deep learning".
result.label: Repeated 'Deep' token

result.description: Weak, mixed target firing on varied tokens (' to', 'ard', 'ores', 'ux') mostly in garbled "effluxes/effluxations require treatment to prevent environmental degradation" waste-pollution text. Silent on ' to' elsewhere; evidence is thin.
result.label: Waste-treatment text, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on tokens in or just after the word "Adapt-" (Adaptive, Adaptation, Adaptability) at the start of titles or documents, e.g. 'pt' in "Adaptive", and on the following word. Silent on some "Adaptive" cases; peaks are mixed.
result.label: Adapt- word pieces in titles

result.description: Fires on the 'lie' piece of "de Broglie" and on "Hyp" in "Broglie Hypothesis", plus some wave-particle duality pieces ("ikel", "icle"). Driven by a " Bro" / "lie" detector members. Tied to the de Broglie wave-particle topic.
result.label: de Broglie name pieces

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside the word "Papyrus" (Pap-yrus, Pam-ph, P-app) and on some commas and "circa" in ancient-history text. Members detect pap/yrus, cuneiform and Rhetoric pieces. Silent on most commas elsewhere.
result.label: Papyrus word pieces and ancient texts

result.description: Fires on 'PI' in the abbreviation "PPIs" right after "Protein-protein interactions (P", at the start of a document about protein interactions. It stays silent on 'PI' in other contexts, such as "Complex PPIs" or "PI configurations".
result.label: PPI abbreviation after protein interactions

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'idence', ' in', 'ities', ' or') that continue a phrase mid-sentence, often after list items or "not just X" constructions. The evidence is mixed, the circuit is a failed fit, and it is mostly comma and legislation-word detectors.
result.label: Mixed mid-phrase commas and suffixes

result.description: Fires on later pieces of long, multi-piece technical words that begin with or contain "od" (odentate ligands, longitudines, dendrimers, melodious, embodied). Driven by an "od" token detector from layer 0; silent on 'ic' in other words.
result.label: Word pieces after 'od' fragment

result.description: Fires on words right after or within "binomial" (omial, coefficients, Theorem, Distribution), in binomial-theorem or probability text. It stays quiet on "coefficients" in other combinatorics or generating-function contexts without "binomial".
result.label: Binomial term continuation

result.description: Fires mostly on " The" and repeated " Deep" tokens in title-like or capitalized name sequences (e.g. "Deep Deep Space", "and The Clash"), plus some word-piece positions. The peaks are mixed, and the members are mostly generic word-piece detectors.
result.label: Repeated 'Deep' / 'The' in names

result.description: Weak, diffuse layer-1 attention latent firing on scattered tokens (' path', ',', '8', ' save', word pieces like 'ingen', ' residents'). It is silent on 'path' inside 'empathy'. Members are generic layer-0 token detectors; the circuit failed.
result.label: Diffuse scattered tokens, 'path' not in empathy

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside volcano-related words (volcano, volcanic, eruption/eruptions, volcanoses) in repetitive volcanic-topic text. Silent on 'ic' in other science words like atmospheric, organic, geologic.
result.label: Volcano word pieces

result.description: Fires on the first word of a line in repeated list-like headings (e.g. " Media" in "Media Financing.¶ Media Budgeting.¶"), plus document-start tokens and some title-case heading words. Weak, mixed evidence; the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Repeated heading-line initial words

result.description: Fires on varied words (he, his, University, synonymous) in biographical text about a person, typically after "his" has been used earlier. Members detect "his" and first names. Peaks are inconsistent and the circuit failed faithfulness.
result.label: Biographical pronoun and "his" context

result.description: Fires on tokens following the word "mission" in a recent context, such as word continuations (missionaries, Impossible), "business", or "was". It seems to carry a "mission" context forward. Peak tokens are scattered, and the circuit's faithfulness is weak.
result.label: Tokens following "mission" context

result.description: Fires mid-word on word pieces (fidget-, discom-, hand-sh-, avoid-ance) in text about body language and nonverbal cues like eye contact, gestures and gaze. Members detect gesture and gaze words.
result.label: Word pieces in body-language text

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word pieces like 'ance', 'shr', 'galax', ' about', 'myster') inside passages about mysterious or hidden phenomena. Members detect 'myster', 'hidden', 'subst' tokens; the target is silent on 'ance' in other contexts.
result.label: Mysterious/hidden-themed passage tokens

result.description: Fires on varied words (gap, dimensional, entered, and) in one passage about art and artists exploring form and materials. Members are mostly art, material and word-piece detectors; the evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Art-passage scattered words (gap, dimensional)

result.description: Fires mostly on the document-start token and on scattered word pieces like ' string' (string theory), 'ical', 'imeter', ' monarch' near the start of a text. It is silent on paragraph-break tokens mid-text. Evidence is mixed and the circuit failed.
result.label: Document-start token and scattered pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " as" when it follows an adjective or verb and introduces a comparison or role (stands tall as, as unremarkable as, perceived as). It stays quiet on "such as", "just as", and "as much".
result.label: " as" after adjective or verb

result.description: Weak, scattered target firing on varied tokens (' be', 'inned', ' their', 'ded') in academic text, often after a verb like "continues to" or "underpinned". Members are mostly generic token detectors; evidence is thin and inconsistent.
result.label: Scattered weak academic-text latent

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (commas, 'the', 'is', 'and', word pieces) inside passages about linear algebra, shortly after the word "linear" appears. Members mostly detect "linear"/algebra/math words. Peak tokens are scattered, so the trigger is unclear.
result.label: Linear algebra context, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires mostly on ' technique', especially at the start of a document or sentence, with occasional hits on word pieces like 'hips' and 'ry'. It stays silent on 'technique' mid-sentence after "this" or an adjective. Members are mostly generic early-layer token detectors.
result.label: ' technique' at sentence start

result.description: Fires on commas, ' by', ' of' and ' and' following a phrase about nuclear fission (e.g. "splits into two smaller nuclei,"). Silent on commas in other nuclear or physics text, so the exact subject or construction is unclear.
result.label: Commas in nuclear fission text

result.description: Fires on ' responsibility' and nearby tokens (the, seriously, lies, comes) in essay-style text about moral or social responsibility and accountability. Members detect ' responsibility', duty, justice and commitment words.
result.label: Responsibility in ethics discussions

result.description: Fires on ' this', ' Further' or the colon in "Further more:" at the very start of a document, as an opening continuation phrase ("Further to this"). Silent on ' this' mid-sentence in later text.
result.label: Document-initial "Further to this"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "argued"/"argue" (e.g. "that", "the", "it", "to", "necessary") in academic or philosophical argument text. Silent on "that" in other positions, such as relative clauses.
result.label: Token following "argued" clause

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (word pieces, commas, function words) inside text about grammatical conjunctions, driven by upstream detectors of 'conjunction', 'connect' and 'coordinate' pieces. Peaks are scattered; silent on ' work' outside this topic.
result.label: Grammar conjunction passages, scattered tokens

result.description: Fires on scattered structural tokens: ' of' after "domain"/"realm"-type nouns, 'm' in "realm", document-start/paragraph breaks, ' an'. Silent on many other ' of' uses, so the condition is unclear. Mixed evidence.
result.label: Scattered 'of'/realm/paragraph-break tokens

result.description: Weak, inconsistent attention-layer target firing on scattered tokens (' to', ' the', 'able', ' approach') in abstract essay-like prose. Members are mostly generic word-piece detectors, and the circuit failed faithfulness, so no clear pattern.
result.label: Scattered function-word peaks, unclear

result.description: Fires on the token right after "born" or "born out/in" (e.g. "of", "from", "in", a space before a year). Members detect "born" and "out" earlier in the text. It stays quiet on "of" in other phrases.
result.label: Token following "born" (born in/out of)

result.description: Fires on scattered positions: newline/period after a short line or document start, markdown separators, table pipes, and mid-word pieces. Members detect start-of-text and line-break tokens. No clear shared meaning; looks like a structural, position-based attention latent.
result.label: Line breaks and document-start structure

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Fund' starting "Fundamental" at the start of a line or heading in a list of titles or topics. It stays silent when the line starts with a number like "2.1.". Also fires weakly on other line-initial word starts (Sc, Ach).
result.label: Line-initial ' Fund' (Fundamental) heading

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (are, is, require, data, commas) in text about real-time operating systems (RTOS), right after the RTOS subject. Members detect RT, OS, time, and OS-related terms. It stays silent on 'are' in other systems text.
result.label: Real-time operating system context

result.description: Fires on varied words (interpret-ations, context, meaning, expressed, present) in abstract academic text about interpretation, symbols and meaning. Silent on 'ations' in other words like generations or motivations. Logits are unclear.
result.label: Interpretation and meaning words in academic text

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in "Co-" words and title-like phrases (Co|ordin|ating, Coefficient of Vari|ation, Pit|falls), after an initial Co/Coo word piece. Silent on some ordin tokens in running grammar text. Members detect Co, oper, at, ordin pieces.
result.label: Co- word continuation pieces (Coordinating)

result.description: Fires on noun-ending suffix tokens like 'ments', 'ings', 'ation' and on 'measurements'/'results' in measurement, calibration and adjustment contexts. Silent on 'ments' in unrelated words (attachments, complements).
result.label: Measurement/adjustment noun endings
Articles 'a'/'an' after verbs/prepositions
result.description: Fires on the indefinite articles ' a' and ' an' (also ' as' in "such as") in abstract, academic prose, mostly after prepositions or verbs like "within", "encompasses", "of". It stays silent on some ' a' after "provide" or "as". Evidence is mixed.
Fires on the end of mathematical noun terms, mostly 'bers' in 'Numbers' (Stirling/Catalan Numbers in topic lists) and ' coefficients', also 'omial'. Weaker on some science terms. Mixed peaks.
result.label: Math term endings: Numbers, coefficients

result.description: Fires on the token " due", mostly in causal "due to" / "partly due" / "largely due" phrases after a verb or adverb. Members include several " due" detectors from early layers and a few " because" detectors.
result.label: ' due' in causal phrases

result.description: Fires on ' that' used as a relative pronoun right after a noun (strategy that, path that, way that), introducing a clause describing that noun. Silent on complementizer 'that' after verbs or adjectives (believed that, ensure that, clear that).
result.label: Relative-pronoun 'that' after noun

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "concept" (e.g. "the concept of Diversity"), introducing the named idea. It stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "rate of", "structure of" or "behavior of".
result.label: " of" after "concept"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens that end or continue a word or title, such as 'ership' in "Leadership" headings, ' commands', ' World', and 'ants'. The peaks are mixed and the circuit is a diffuse set of token-level detectors, so no single trigger stands out.
result.label: Mixed word-ending tokens, 'ership'

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare or technical words split into pieces (Zer-oth, Eu-cl-id, Polym-er, Dar-win), mostly in science and math text. Peak tokens are varied sub-word pieces; the evidence for a single trigger is weak.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of technical terms

result.description: Mixed target peaking on mid-word pieces like 'rop', ' anni', and Arabic or garbled byte characters inside words, plus some function words. Members are mostly generic word-piece and Arabic detectors, so the evidence is thin and mixed.
result.label: Mid-word fragments, Arabic letters

result.description: Fires on drama/theatre words, mainly ' dialog' (before 'ue'), also ' dram' (before 'atic'), ' theatre' and ' drama', in scriptwriting and stage text. Members are detectors of these tokens.
result.label: Dialog/drama/theatre word pieces

result.description: Fires in calculus/math text on tokens like "of" after "derivative", "function", and "able" in "differentiable", where a function or derivative is being discussed. Silent on "able" in non-math words like "manageable".
result.label: Calculus derivative-of-function tokens

result.description: Fires on opening brackets or braces (like '{', '_{', '(', '[') inside LaTeX or math notation, such as \mathbf{, \vec{, or \Psi(. Silent on ordinary prose.
result.label: Opening brackets in LaTeX math

result.description: Fires on commas (also hyphens or "to") separating numbers in lists, year sequences and numeric ranges, e.g. "1958, 1967," or "8, 9,". Silent on commas in ordinary prose clauses.
result.label: Separators between numbers in sequences
' cons' in "consolidation" (synaptic)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cons' at the start of "consolidation", mostly after "synaptic" or "phases of" in memory-neuroscience text. Weak activation on ' intent'. Members are mostly ' cons' token detectors.

Fires on the word-initial fragment ' w' (and sometimes ' am') when it is a split-off start of a longer word like wavelength, wail, wool, widespread, and predicts continuations such as 'avel', 'ired', 'ield'.
result.label: Word-initial ' w' fragment

result.description: Fires weakly and diffusely on varied mid-sentence tokens (job, action, by, useful, combining) in academic or technical prose. Peaks have low consistency and the logits are mixed, so no clear trigger or condition emerges.
result.label: Diffuse academic-prose mid-phrase tokens

result.description: Fires on varied tokens, mostly ' measurements', ' direction', ' measured' and Arabic 'ى', in geodesy/measurement-style technical text (latitude, longitude, reference, datums). Silent on ' measurements' at the start of a document. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Measurement/geodesy terms, mixed tokens

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' al' that starts a longer word (alloy, alliance, aluminum, alphabet) or an Arabic name particle (al-). Members are mostly ' al'/' Al' token detectors. Predicts continuations like 'loy' and 'umin'.
result.label: ' al' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on the token " from", most strongly after nouns or verbs of distance, source or separation (distance from, row from, subtracting from). Many members are detectors of " from". The contrast text has no " from".
result.label: ' from' after distance/source words

result.description: Fires on social media platform names (YouTube, Facebook, especially in lists like "Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube") and on the word "updates"/"updated". Members detect Facebook/Twitter/YouTube and "updates" tokens separately. Mixed peaks, so a loose word set.
result.label: Social media names and "updates"

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in specific rare words: "ament"/"amental"/"ate" after "orn" (ornamental, ornate) and "i" in "axioms". Silent on "i" in "concerti". Mixed token pieces tied to particular words.
result.label: Mid-word pieces: ornament, axiom

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces after an initial 'e'/'E' or in lists: hyphens in "2e-3e-4e", 'ol' in "Aeolian", 'vol', 'cos', 'conom', and the period in "e.g."/"i.e." It looks like a fragment-continuation feature; peaks are scattered.
result.label: Word fragments after initial 'e'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'rog' inside "interrogative" (also weakly on 'ative' in it). Members are detectors of 'rog' and 'ative' pieces; contrast is unrelated text.
result.label: 'rog' in "interrogative"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece 'ile' right after 'host' (hostile), and also on 'aje' in 'Sarajevo'. It is silent on 'ile' in other words like 'fertile'. Weaker on a few other tokens after 'hot' or 'stable'.
result.label: 'ile' in 'hostile' word piece
